rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: Tell me about the kind of accommodation you live in.
rows.translation: 請你講一下你住的是甚麼類型的住所。

rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: Do you live in a house or a flat?
rows.translation: 你住的是房子還是單位？

rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: Is it a big place?
rows.translation: 那個地方大嗎？

rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: Does the place you live in have many amenities?
rows.translation: 你住的地方有很多配套設施嗎？

rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: What do you like about living there?
rows.translation: 你喜歡住在那裡的甚麼地方？

rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: Is there anything you would like to change about the place you live in?
rows.translation: 你會想改變你現在住的地方的任何部分嗎？

rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: How long have you lived there?
rows.translation: 你在那裡住了多久？

rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: Do you plan to live there for a long time?
rows.translation: 你打算在那裡住很長時間嗎？

rows.title: Accommodation
rows.text: Is there a garden in the place you live in?
rows.translation: 你住的地方有花園嗎？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Do you like watching advertisements?
rows.translation: 你喜歡看廣告嗎？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Where do you usually see advertisements these days?
rows.translation: 你現在通常在哪裡看到廣告？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: What kinds of advertisements usually catch your attention?
rows.translation: 哪一類廣告通常會吸引你的注意？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Will you buy something because of an advertisement?
rows.translation: 你會因為一則廣告而去買東西嗎？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Have you ever bought something after seeing it advertised?
rows.translation: 你有沒有試過在看完廣告之後買東西？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: How do you feel when you see pop-up ads on the internet?
rows.translation: 當你在網上看到彈出式廣告時，你有甚麼感覺？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Do you think there are too many advertisements on the internet nowadays?
rows.translation: 你覺得現今互聯網上的廣告是不是太多了？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Do you like funny or serious advertisements?
rows.translation: 你喜歡搞笑的還是嚴肅的廣告？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: What kind of advertisements do you dislike?
rows.translation: 你不喜歡哪一類廣告？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Do you think advertisements are useful?
rows.translation: 你覺得廣告有用嗎？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Do you prefer advertisements on TV or on social media?
rows.translation: 你較喜歡電視廣告還是社交媒體廣告？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: What makes a good advertisement?
rows.translation: 甚麼元素會令一則廣告成為好的廣告？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Do you like art?
rows.translation: 你喜歡藝術嗎？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Do you think art classes are necessary?
rows.translation: 你認為藝術課是必要的嗎？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: How do you think art classes affect children’s development?
rows.translation: 你認為藝術課會怎樣影響孩子的發展？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: What benefits can you get from painting as a hobby?
rows.translation: 把繪畫當成興趣可以帶來甚麼好處？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Do you like to take photographs?
rows.translation: 你喜歡拍照嗎？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Do you prefer to take photos yourself or to have other people take photos?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡自己拍照，還是讓別人替你拍？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: How often do you take photographs?
rows.translation: 你多常拍照？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Do you prefer to take pictures of people or of scenery?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡拍人，還是拍風景？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Do you prefer to take photos with a phone or with a camera?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡用手機還是相機拍照？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Do you take many photographs when you travel?
rows.translation: 你旅行時會拍很多照片嗎？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Do you like looking at photographs of yourself?
rows.translation: 你喜歡看自己的照片嗎？

rows.title: Art & Photography
rows.text: Have you put any photographs you have taken on the walls in your house?
rows.translation: 你有沒有把自己拍的照片掛在家裡的牆上？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Have you ever taken a ride on a boat?
rows.translation: 你有沒有坐過船？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Do you like travelling by boat?
rows.translation: 你喜歡乘船旅行嗎？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: How often do people travel by boat in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家的人多常坐船出行？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Is travelling by boat common where you live?
rows.translation: 你住的地方乘船出行普遍嗎？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: What are the advantages of travelling by boat?
rows.translation: 乘船旅行有甚麼好處？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Are there any disadvantages of travelling by boat?
rows.translation: 乘船旅行有沒有甚麼壞處？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Would you like to go on a long boat trip?
rows.translation: 你想不想參加一次長途船旅？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Do you prefer travelling by boat or by plane?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡坐船還是坐飛機？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: What kinds of boats are common in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家常見的是甚麼種類的船？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Do people in your country like to travel by boat?
rows.translation: 你國家的人喜歡乘船旅行嗎？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Why do some people enjoy boat trips?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人喜歡坐船旅行？

rows.title: Boat
rows.text: Will travelling by boat get more popular in the future?
rows.translation: 未來乘船旅行會不會變得更受歡迎？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Do you usually carry a bag with you?
rows.translation: 你平時會隨身帶袋嗎？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: What kind of bag do you usually use?
rows.translation: 你通常會用哪一種袋？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Do you prefer big bags or small bags?
rows.translation: 你較喜歡大袋還是小袋？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: What do you usually keep in your bag?
rows.translation: 你通常會在袋裡放些甚麼？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Have you ever lost a bag?
rows.translation: 你有沒有試過弄丟袋？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Do you think bags are important in daily life?
rows.translation: 你覺得袋在日常生活中重要嗎？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Do you often buy new bags?
rows.translation: 你經常買新袋嗎？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: What kinds of bags are popular in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，哪一類袋比較流行？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Do men and women usually use different kinds of bags?
rows.translation: 男性和女性通常會用不同類型的袋嗎？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Do you prefer bags that are practical or fashionable?
rows.translation: 你較喜歡實用的袋還是時尚的袋？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Have the types of bags people use changed over time?
rows.translation: 人們使用的袋的種類有沒有隨時間改變？

rows.title: Bags
rows.text: Do you think people will use bags differently in the future?
rows.translation: 你覺得未來人們會以不同方式使用袋嗎？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Do you usually celebrate your birthday every year?
rows.translation: 你每年通常都會慶祝生日嗎？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: What did you usually do on your birthday when you were a child?
rows.translation: 你小時候通常會怎樣過生日？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Did you enjoy birthdays more when you were younger?
rows.translation: 你年紀較小的時候是不是更享受生日？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: How do you normally celebrate your birthday now?
rows.translation: 你現在通常怎樣慶祝生日？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Do you prefer to celebrate your birthday with family or friends?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡和家人還是和朋友慶祝生日？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: What kind of birthday gifts do you like to receive?
rows.translation: 你喜歡收到甚麼類型的生日禮物？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Do you usually give birthday gifts to other people?
rows.translation: 你通常會送生日禮物給別人嗎？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Is your birthday now still as important to you as when you were a child?
rows.translation: 你現在的生日還像小時候那樣重要嗎？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Do you think it’s important to celebrate birthdays?
rows.translation: 你認為慶祝生日重要嗎？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Do you think it’s important to give someone a card on their birthday?
rows.translation: 你認為在別人生日的時候送一張卡重要嗎？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Do you think the price of gifts is important?
rows.translation: 你認為禮物的價錢重要嗎？

rows.title: Birthdays
rows.text: Do people in your country usually have birthday parties?
rows.translation: 你國家的人通常會辦生日派對嗎？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do you like reading books? Why?
rows.translation: 你喜歡看書嗎？為甚麼？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: How often do you read?
rows.translation: 你多常閱讀？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do you have many books at home?
rows.translation: 你家裡有很多書嗎？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do you prefer to buy books or borrow them?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡買書還是借書？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: What are the benefits of reading?
rows.translation: 閱讀有甚麼好處？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: What book would you take on a long journey?
rows.translation: 如果要去長途旅程，你會帶哪一本書？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: How easy is it for you to read books in English?
rows.translation: 對你來說，用英文看書容易嗎？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Have you given up reading a book recently?
rows.translation: 你最近有放棄看一本書嗎？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: What kind of people like reading and what kind of people don’t like reading very much?
rows.translation: 甚麼樣的人喜歡閱讀，而甚麼樣的人不太喜歡閱讀？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: What kinds of books do you like to read?
rows.translation: 你喜歡看哪一類書？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: What is the best book you’ve ever read?
rows.translation: 你讀過最好的一本書是甚麼？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Is reading books a popular activity in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，閱讀是受歡迎的活動嗎？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do you think that electronic books / eReaders are better than real books?
rows.translation: 你認為電子書／電子閱讀器比實體書更好嗎？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Who is your favourite celebrity?
rows.translation: 你最喜歡的名人是誰？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: What kind of celebrity do you usually admire?
rows.translation: 你通常欣賞哪一類名人？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Do you like any foreign celebrities?
rows.translation: 你喜歡任何外國名人嗎？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: How do you usually find out about celebrities?
rows.translation: 你通常怎樣得知名人的消息？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Why do people become interested in celebrities?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們會對名人感興趣？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Are celebrities important in your country?
rows.translation: 名人在你的國家重要嗎？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Would you like to meet a celebrity one day?
rows.translation: 你將來想見到名人嗎？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Would you want to be a celebrity in the future?
rows.translation: 你將來想成為名人嗎？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Do you think being a celebrity is easy or difficult?
rows.translation: 你認為當名人是容易還是困難？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Do you think we should protect famous people’s privacy?
rows.translation: 你認為我們應該保護名人的私隱嗎？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: How do celebrities influence their fans in your country?
rows.translation: 名人在你的國家會怎樣影響他們的粉絲？

rows.title: Celebrity
rows.text: Do you think celebrities have a responsibility to set a good example?
rows.translation: 你認為名人有責任樹立好榜樣嗎？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: What is your favourite item of clothing?
rows.translation: 你最喜歡的衣物是甚麼？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: What kind of clothes do you usually like to wear?
rows.translation: 你通常喜歡穿甚麼類型的衣服？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: Do you prefer comfortable clothes or fashionable clothes?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡舒服的衣服還是時尚的衣服？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: Where do you usually purchase your clothes?
rows.translation: 你通常在哪裡買衣服？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: Have you ever bought clothes online?
rows.translation: 你曾經在網上買過衣服嗎？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: How often do you buy new clothes?
rows.translation: 你多常買新衣服？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: Were you interested in fashion when you were a child?
rows.translation: 你小時候對時尚有興趣嗎？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: Is fashion important to you now?
rows.translation: 時尚現在對你來說重要嗎？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: Are there any traditional clothes in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家有沒有一些傳統服飾？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: What types of clothes are fashionable for young people in your country these days?
rows.translation: 你國家現在年輕人流行穿甚麼類型的衣服？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: Does fashion change for people as they get older?
rows.translation: 隨著年紀增長，人們的時尚風格會改變嗎？

rows.title: Clothes, Fashion
rows.text: Have your tastes in clothes changed over time?
rows.translation: 你對衣服的品味有隨著時間改變嗎？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: What colours do you like?
rows.translation: 你喜歡甚麼顏色？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: Are there any colours you dislike?
rows.translation: 你有沒有不喜歡的顏色？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: Did you like the same colours when you were a child?
rows.translation: 你小時候也喜歡同樣的顏色嗎？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: What colours do you usually wear?
rows.translation: 你平時通常會穿甚麼顏色？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: Do you like to wear dark or bright colours?
rows.translation: 你喜歡穿深色還是鮮色？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: Are there any colours you would never wear?
rows.translation: 有沒有甚麼顏色是你絕對不會穿的？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: What’s the most popular colour in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，最受歡迎的顏色是甚麼？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: What colours are commonly used in homes in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，家居通常會用甚麼顏色？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: What’s the difference between men’s and women’s preferences for colours?
rows.translation: 男性和女性在顏色喜好方面有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: Do colours affect your mood?
rows.translation: 顏色會影響你的心情嗎？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: Do you think colours can influence people’s decisions?
rows.translation: 你覺得顏色會影響人們的決定嗎？

rows.title: Colours
rows.text: Do colours have special meanings in your culture?
rows.translation: 在你的文化裡，顏色有沒有特別的含義？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Do you use computers?
rows.translation: 你有使用電腦嗎？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: How often do you use a computer?
rows.translation: 你多常使用電腦？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: What do you usually use a computer for?
rows.translation: 你通常用電腦來做甚麼？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Do you use a computer for work or study?
rows.translation: 你會用電腦來工作或學習嗎？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Do you prefer using a computer or a phone?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡用電腦還是手機？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Are you good at using computers?
rows.translation: 你擅長使用電腦嗎？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Did you use computers when you were little?
rows.translation: 你小時候有用電腦嗎？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: When did you first start using a computer?
rows.translation: 你是甚麼時候開始用電腦的？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Do people often use computers these days?
rows.translation: 現在人們常常使用電腦嗎？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Do you think computers are important in everyday life?
rows.translation: 你認為電腦在日常生活中重要嗎？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Are there any things you prefer not to do on a computer?
rows.translation: 有沒有一些事情是你比較不喜歡在電腦上做的？

rows.title: Computer
rows.text: Will people continue to use computers in the future?
rows.translation: 人們未來還會繼續使用電腦嗎？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: What is your country famous for?
rows.translation: 你的國家以甚麼聞名？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: What do you like most about your country?
rows.translation: 你最喜歡你的國家的甚麼地方？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: Are there any places in your country that you would like to visit?
rows.translation: 你的國家有沒有甚麼地方是你想去的？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: Where do you live in your country?
rows.translation: 你在你的國家住在哪裡？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: What is that part of your country like?
rows.translation: 你住的那一部分地方是怎樣的？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: Is it an interesting place to live?
rows.translation: 那是一個有趣的地方住嗎？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: What do people from other countries usually know about your country?
rows.translation: 其他國家的人通常對你的國家有甚麼認識？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: What kind of food is your country known for?
rows.translation: 你的國家以甚麼食物聞名？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: Do many tourists visit your country?
rows.translation: 你的國家有很多遊客來訪嗎？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: What do you think is the best thing about living in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為住在你的國家最好的一點是甚麼？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: Has your country changed much in recent years?
rows.translation: 你的國家近年改變大嗎？

rows.title: Country
rows.text: Are you planning to live there in the future?
rows.translation: 你將來打算住在那裡嗎？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Tell me about your daily routine.
rows.translation: 請你講一下你的日常作息。

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: What do you usually do in the morning?
rows.translation: 你早上通常會做甚麼？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: What do you usually do in the evening?
rows.translation: 你晚上通常會做甚麼？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Is your daily routine usually busy?
rows.translation: 你的日常作息通常忙碌嗎？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Is your daily routine different at the weekend from during the week?
rows.translation: 你的週末作息和星期中的作息有分別嗎？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: What part of your daily routine do you enjoy the most?
rows.translation: 你最喜歡日常作息中的哪一部分？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Has your daily routine changed since you were a child?
rows.translation: 你的日常作息自小時候以來有改變嗎？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Do you prefer a fixed routine or a flexible one?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡固定的作息，還是彈性的作息？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: What would you like to change about your daily routine?
rows.translation: 你想改變你的日常作息中的甚麼？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Do you think it’s important to have a daily routine?
rows.translation: 你認為有日常作息重要嗎？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Do people in your country usually have regular daily routines?
rows.translation: 你國家的人通常有規律的日常作息嗎？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Do you think your daily routine will change in the future?
rows.translation: 你覺得你未來的日常作息會改變嗎？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Do you ever use a dictionary?
rows.translation: 你有沒有用字典的習慣？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: How often do you use a dictionary?
rows.translation: 你多常使用字典？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: What do you usually use a dictionary for?
rows.translation: 你通常會用字典來做甚麼？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Do you prefer paper or electronic dictionaries?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡紙本字典還是電子字典？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Why do you prefer that kind of dictionary?
rows.translation: 你為甚麼比較喜歡那一種字典？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Did you use dictionaries more when you were younger?
rows.translation: 你年紀較小的時候是不是更常用字典？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Did your teachers encourage you to use dictionaries at school?
rows.translation: 你以前在學校時，老師有鼓勵你用字典嗎？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Are dictionaries used a lot in schools in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家的學校裡會很常用字典嗎？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Do you think dictionaries are useful for learning a language?
rows.translation: 你認為字典對學語言有用嗎？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Do people still need dictionaries now that they can search online?
rows.translation: 既然現在大家都可以上網搜尋，你覺得人們還需要字典嗎？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: What kind of information do you usually look up in a dictionary?
rows.translation: 你通常會在字典裡查哪一類資料？

rows.title: Dictionaries
rows.text: Do you think people will use dictionaries in the future?
rows.translation: 你覺得將來人們還會使用字典嗎？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do you dream much at night?
rows.translation: 你晚上常常做夢嗎？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do you often remember your dreams?
rows.translation: 你常常記得自己的夢嗎？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: What kind of dreams do you usually have?
rows.translation: 你通常會做甚麼樣的夢？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do you usually have pleasant dreams or bad dreams?
rows.translation: 你通常做的是好夢還是惡夢？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Have you ever had the same dream more than once?
rows.translation: 你有沒有做過同一個夢超過一次？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Have you ever had a dream that felt very real?
rows.translation: 你有沒有做過一個感覺非常真實的夢？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do you ever talk to other people about your dreams?
rows.translation: 你會跟別人談起你的夢嗎？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do you think we can learn anything from dreams?
rows.translation: 你覺得我們能從夢裡學到甚麼嗎？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do people in your country talk about their dreams?
rows.translation: 你國家的人會談論自己的夢嗎？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do you think dreams are related to what happens in daily life?
rows.translation: 你覺得夢和日常生活發生的事情有關嗎？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do you think some people care more about dreams than others?
rows.translation: 你覺得有些人會比其他人更在意夢嗎？

rows.title: Dreams
rows.text: Do you think that dreams can come true?
rows.translation: 你覺得夢想可以成真嗎？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: What kinds of emails do you receive about your work or studies?
rows.translation: 你會收到哪些與工作或學業有關的電郵？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: Do you prefer to email, phone, or text your friends?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡用電郵、打電話，還是發訊息給朋友？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: Do you reply to emails as soon as you receive them?
rows.translation: 你會一收到電郵就馬上回覆嗎？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: Are you happy to receive emails that are advertising things?
rows.translation: 你喜歡收到宣傳產品或服務的廣告電郵嗎？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: Do you email people often?
rows.translation: 你會經常發電郵給別人嗎？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: Do you chat with friends or family more with email?
rows.translation: 你會比較常用電郵和朋友或家人聊天嗎？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: Do you think people prefer to receive an email or a letter?
rows.translation: 你認為人們比較喜歡收到電郵還是信件？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: Do you think it’s easier to write an email or a letter?
rows.translation: 你認為寫電郵還是寫信比較容易？

rows.title: Email
rows.text: Do you think email will eventually replace letter writing?
rows.translation: 你認為電郵最終會取代寫信嗎？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: Do you do much exercise?
rows.translation: 你平時做很多運動嗎？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: How often do you exercise?
rows.translation: 你多久做一次運動？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: What kind of exercise do you usually do?
rows.translation: 你通常做哪一類運動？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: Do you prefer exercising alone or with other people?
rows.translation: 你較喜歡自己運動，還是和別人一起運動？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: Where do you usually go to exercise?
rows.translation: 你通常去哪裡做運動？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: What do you usually do to keep fit?
rows.translation: 你通常做些甚麼來保持健康？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: Did you do more exercise when you were a child?
rows.translation: 你小時候做的運動有沒有更多？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: Do you think you get enough exercise?
rows.translation: 你覺得自己有做足夠的運動嗎？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: Do people in your country do a lot of exercise?
rows.translation: 你國家的人做很多運動嗎？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: What do you think is the best exercise to keep fit?
rows.translation: 你認為保持健康最好的運動是甚麼？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: Have the types of exercise people like to do changed since you were a child?
rows.translation: 自從你小時候以來，人們喜歡做的運動種類有改變嗎？

rows.title: Exercise
rows.text: Do you think people will exercise more in the future?
rows.translation: 你覺得未來人們會做更多運動嗎？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: How many people are there in your immediate family?
rows.translation: 你的直系家人有多少人？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Who do you get on best within your family?
rows.translation: 在家人之中，你和誰最合得來？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Do you have a large extended family?
rows.translation: 你有一個龐大的大家族嗎？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: What do you do together with your family?
rows.translation: 你會和家人一起做些甚麼？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Why is family important to you?
rows.translation: 為甚麼家人對你來說很重要？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Do you do housework at home?
rows.translation: 你在家會做家務嗎？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: What kind of housework do you often do?
rows.translation: 你經常做哪一類家務？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Did you do housework when you were a child?
rows.translation: 你小時候有做家務嗎？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Do you think that children should do housework?
rows.translation: 你認為小朋友應該做家務嗎？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Do you all live in the same house?
rows.translation: 你們是否全部住在同一間屋裡？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Who is your favourite family member?
rows.translation: 你最喜歡的家庭成員是誰？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Do you have a large family or a small family?
rows.translation: 你有一個大家庭還是一個小家庭？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Can you tell me something about your family members?
rows.translation: 你可以講一點關於你家人的事情嗎？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: How much time do you manage to spend with members of your family?
rows.translation: 你大概能花多少時間和家人在一起？

rows.title: Family & Housework
rows.text: Do you get on well with your family? Why?
rows.translation: 你和家人相處得好嗎？為甚麼？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Do you like flowers?
rows.translation: 你喜歡花嗎？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: What kinds of flowers do you like?
rows.translation: 你喜歡哪一種花？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Are flowers important in your country?
rows.translation: 花在你的國家重要嗎？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Have you ever given anybody flowers?
rows.translation: 你有沒有送過花給別人？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Is it popular to give flowers to people in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，送花給別人受歡迎嗎？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: On what special occasions do people give flowers in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，人們通常會在甚麼特別場合送花？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Have you ever received flowers from someone?
rows.translation: 你有沒有收過別人送的花？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: What kinds of flowers would you like to receive as a present?
rows.translation: 你想收到甚麼種類的花作為禮物？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Do you prefer to give flowers or other kinds of gifts?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡送花，還是送其他種類的禮物？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Do people in your country keep flowers at home?
rows.translation: 你國家的人會在家裡放花嗎？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Have you ever grown flowers yourself?
rows.translation: 你有沒有自己種過花？

rows.title: Flowers
rows.text: Do you prefer real flowers or artificial flowers?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡真花還是假花？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Do you have a lot of friends?
rows.translation: 你有很多朋友嗎？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: How often do you see your friends?
rows.translation: 你多常見朋友？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: What do you usually do when you meet your friends?
rows.translation: 你和朋友見面時通常會做甚麼？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Do you prefer spending time with one friend or with a group of friends?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡和一位朋友相處，還是一群朋友一起？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Who is your best friend and why?
rows.translation: 你最好的朋友是誰？為甚麼？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: How did you become friends with your best friend?
rows.translation: 你和你最好的朋友是怎樣成為朋友的？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: What kind of person can you make friends with easily?
rows.translation: 你比較容易和甚麼樣的人做朋友？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: What qualities do you look for in a friend?
rows.translation: 你會在朋友身上看重哪些特質？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Is it easy for you to make new friends?
rows.translation: 對你來說，結交新朋友容易嗎？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Do you still keep in touch with your childhood friends?
rows.translation: 你現在還有和童年朋友保持聯絡嗎？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Who would you most like to be friends with and why?
rows.translation: 你最想和誰做朋友？為甚麼？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Which is more important to you, friends or family?
rows.translation: 對你來說，朋友和家人哪一樣更重要？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Do you enjoy cooking?
rows.translation: 你喜歡煮食嗎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: What type of things can you cook?
rows.translation: 你會煮哪一類食物？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: What kinds of food are popular in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，哪一類食物比較受歡迎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Is it an important part of your culture to have dinner parties?
rows.translation: 在你的文化裡，舉行晚餐聚會是不是很重要的一部分？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Do you prefer to eat with other people or on your own?
rows.translation: 你較喜歡和別人一起吃，還是自己一個人吃？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Do you have a healthy diet?
rows.translation: 你的飲食健康嗎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Do you prefer eating at home or eating out?
rows.translation: 你較喜歡在家吃還是外出吃？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Do you like ordering food to be delivered?
rows.translation: 你喜歡叫外賣送上門嗎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Who do you get food delivered with?
rows.translation: 你通常和誰一起叫外賣？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Do you eat meals differently now compared to when you were little?
rows.translation: 你現在吃飯的方式，和你小時候相比有不同嗎？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: Do you enjoy giving gifts to other people?
rows.translation: 你喜歡送禮物給別人嗎？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: Do you prefer giving gifts or receiving them?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡送禮物還是收禮物？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: What kinds of gifts do you usually give?
rows.translation: 你通常會送甚麼類型的禮物？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: Do you usually buy gifts in advance or at the last minute?
rows.translation: 你通常會提早買禮物還是最後一刻才買？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: Do you think handmade gifts are a good idea?
rows.translation: 你覺得手作禮物是一個好主意嗎？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: When do you send gifts?
rows.translation: 你通常會在甚麼時候送禮？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: When was the last time you received a gift?
rows.translation: 你上一次收到禮物是甚麼時候？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: Have you received a gift you didn’t like?
rows.translation: 你有沒有收過自己不喜歡的禮物？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: How do you feel when you receive a gift?
rows.translation: 當你收到禮物時，你會有甚麼感覺？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: What kinds of gifts do you like to receive?
rows.translation: 你喜歡收到甚麼類型的禮物？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: Do people in your country send gifts to show their generosity?
rows.translation: 你國家的人會透過送禮來表達他們的慷慨嗎？

rows.title: Gifts
rows.text: Is it important to choose the right gift for someone?
rows.translation: 為別人選對禮物重要嗎？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Did you enjoy your life in high school?
rows.translation: 你享受你的高中生活嗎？

rows.text: What was your high school like?
rows.translation: 你的高中是怎樣的？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Did you go to a big high school or a small one?
rows.translation: 你讀的是一間大型高中還是一間小型高中？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Who was your favourite teacher in high school?
rows.translation: 你高中時最喜歡的老師是誰？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: What was your favourite subject in high school?
rows.translation: 你高中時最喜歡的科目是甚麼？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Was there any subject you did not like in high school?
rows.translation: 你高中時有沒有甚麼不喜歡的科目？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Do you still remember what happened on your first day of high school?
rows.translation: 你還記得高中第一天發生了甚麼嗎？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Did you take part in any clubs or activities in high school?
rows.translation: 你高中時有參加任何學會或活動嗎？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Did you wear a school uniform in high school?
rows.translation: 你高中時有穿校服嗎？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Do you still keep in touch with your friends from high school?
rows.translation: 你現在還有和高中朋友保持聯絡嗎？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Do you think high school is an important stage in a person’s life?
rows.translation: 你認為高中是不是人生中一個重要階段？

rows.title: High School
rows.text: Do you miss your life in high school?
rows.translation: 你懷念你的高中生活嗎？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: Where is your hometown?
rows.translation: 你的家鄉在哪裡？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: What do you like about it?
rows.translation: 你喜歡它的甚麼地方？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: What do you not like about it?
rows.translation: 你不喜歡它的甚麼地方？

rows.translation: 你的家鄉有甚麼方法可以變得更好嗎？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: How important is your hometown to you?
rows.translation: 你的家鄉對你有多重要？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: Can you tell me about your hometown?
rows.translation: 你可以介紹一下你的家鄉嗎？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: How has your hometown changed over the years?
rows.translation: 你的家鄉這些年來有甚麼改變？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: Do you think you will continue to live in your hometown?
rows.translation: 你覺得你會繼續住在你的家鄉嗎？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: How often do you visit your hometown?
rows.translation: 你多常回家鄉？

rows.text: How many people live in your hometown?
rows.translation: 你的家鄉有多少人居住？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: What kind of jobs do the people in your hometown do?
rows.translation: 你家鄉的人通常從事甚麼工作？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: What is your hometown famous for?
rows.translation: 你的家鄉以甚麼聞名？

rows.title: Hometown
rows.text: What’s the oldest part of your hometown?
rows.translation: 你家鄉最古老的部分是哪裡？

rows.title: Noise
rows.text: Do you mind noise?
rows.translation: 你介意噪音嗎？

rows.title: Noise
rows.text: What types of noise do you come across in your daily life?
rows.translation: 你在日常生活中會遇到哪些類型的噪音？

rows.title: Noise
rows.text: Are there any sounds that you like?
rows.translation: 你有沒有一些喜歡的聲音？

rows.title: Noise
rows.text: Are there any sounds that you dislike?
rows.translation: 你有沒有一些不喜歡的聲音？

rows.title: Noise
rows.text: Do you prefer quiet places or noisy places?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡安靜的地方還是嘈吵的地方？

rows.title: Noise
rows.text: Do you think you are sensitive to noise?
rows.translation: 你覺得自己對噪音敏感嗎？

rows.title: Noise
rows.text: Where can you hear loud noises?
rows.translation: 你可以在哪些地方聽到很大的噪音？

rows.text: Is your home usually quiet or noisy?
rows.translation: 你家通常是安靜還是嘈吵的？

rows.translation: 你小時候住的地方嘈吵嗎？

rows.translation: 你覺得現代社會裡的噪音是不是太多了？

rows.translation: 城市是不是正在變得更嘈吵？

rows.title: Noise
rows.text: What can people do to reduce noise in cities?
rows.translation: 人們可以做些甚麼來減少城市噪音？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Who do you live with?
rows.translation: 你和誰一起住？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Do you live in a house or a flat?
rows.translation: 你住的是房子還是單位？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: How long have you lived there?
rows.translation: 你在那裡住了多久？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Is your home big or small?
rows.translation: 你的家大還是小？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: What is your favourite room in your home?
rows.translation: 你家裡最喜歡哪一個房間？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: What do you usually do in that room?
rows.translation: 你通常會在那個房間裡做甚麼？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: How is your home decorated?
rows.translation: 你的家是怎樣裝飾的？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: What do you like most about your home?
rows.translation: 你最喜歡你家的甚麼地方？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Is there anything you would like to change about your home?
rows.translation: 你會想改變家裡的任何地方嗎？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Do you like visitors coming to your home?
rows.translation: 你喜歡有客人來你家嗎？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Do you think you will live there for a long time?
rows.translation: 你覺得你會在那裡住很長時間嗎？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: What kind of home would you like to have in the future?
rows.translation: 你未來想擁有一個怎樣的家？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Do you have a good sense of humour?
rows.translation: 你有幽默感嗎？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: What kind of things make you laugh?
rows.translation: 甚麼類型的事情會令你發笑？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Do you like watching funny programmes on TV?
rows.translation: 你喜歡看電視上的搞笑節目嗎？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: What type of programmes do you find funny on TV?
rows.translation: 你覺得哪一類電視節目最好笑？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Which types of programmes are most popular in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，哪一類節目最受歡迎？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Do people in your country enjoy comedy programmes?
rows.translation: 你國家的人喜歡喜劇節目嗎？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Do you like to make people laugh?
rows.translation: 你喜歡逗人笑嗎？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Are you good at telling jokes?
rows.translation: 你擅長講笑話嗎？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Who is the funniest person you know?
rows.translation: 你認識的人裡，誰是最有趣的人？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Do you think humour is important in daily life?
rows.translation: 你覺得幽默在日常生活中重要嗎？

rows.text: Can humour help people relax?
rows.translation: 幽默可以幫助人放鬆嗎？

rows.title: Humour
rows.text: Has your sense of humour changed as you have got older?

rows.text: Do you prefer public transportation or private transportation?

rows.text: Describe a trip you took by public transport.
rows.translation: 描述一次你乘搭公共交通工具的旅程。

rows.title: Travel
rows.text: Describe a journey you have been on.
rows.translation: 描述一段你曾經經歷過的旅程。

rows.title: Tourist Activity
rows.text: Talk about something tourists like to do in your country.
rows.translation: 談談一些遊客在你的國家或地方喜歡做的事情。

rows.title: A Day Trip You Have Been On
rows.text: Talk about a day trip you have been on.
rows.translation: 談談你曾經去過的一次即日來回旅行。

rows.title: A Part of Your Country You Have Never Been To but Would Like to Visit
rows.text: Talk about a part of your country you have never been to but would like to visit.
rows.translation: 談談你國家裡一個你從未去過、但想去的地方。

rows.title: Foreign Country
rows.text: Talk about a foreign country you have never been to but would like to visit.
rows.translation: 談談一個你從未去過、但很想去的外國。

rows.title: Country
rows.text: Describe a country you would like to visit in the future you haven’t been to yet.
rows.translation: 描述一個你將來想去、但還未去過的國家。

rows.title: Lake, River or Sea
rows.text: Describe a lake, a river or a sea you have visited.
rows.translation: 描述一個你曾經去過的湖泊、河流或海洋。

rows.title: Holiday
rows.text: Describe a holiday that you recently went on that you enjoyed.
rows.translation: 描述一個你最近去過而且很享受的假期。

rows.title: Traditional Product
rows.text: Describe a traditional product in your country.
rows.translation: 描述一樣你國家或地方的傳統產品。

rows.title: TV
rows.text: Describe a TV programme that you often watch.
rows.translation: 描述一個你經常觀看的電視節目。

rows.title: Weather
rows.text: Describe a time when the weather prevented you from doing something.
rows.translation: 描述一次天氣令你無法做某件事的經歷。

rows.title: Vegetables
rows.text: Describe a plant, vegetable or crop that you are familiar with.
rows.translation: 描述一種你熟悉的植物、蔬菜或農作物。

rows.title: Work
rows.text: Describe your dream job.
rows.translation: 描述你的理想工作。

rows.title: Dream Workplace
rows.text: Describe your dream workplace.
rows.translation: 描述你的夢想工作場所。

rows.title: Job
rows.text: Talk about a job you have done or know about.
rows.translation: 談談一份你做過或知道的工作。

rows.title: Family Job
rows.text: Talk about a job someone in your family does.
rows.translation: 談談你家裡某個人正在做的一份工作。

rows.title: A Workplace You Have Worked In or Know About
rows.text: Describe a workplace you have worked in or know about.
rows.translation: 描述一個你工作過或者知道的工作場所。

rows.title: A Job You Would Like to Do in the Future
rows.text: Describe a job you would like to do in the future.
rows.translation: 描述一份你將來想做的工作。

rows.title: Communication (event/occasion)
rows.text: Describe a piece of advice you recently received.
rows.translation: 描述一個你最近收到的建議。

rows.title: Embarrassment (event/occasion)
rows.text: Describe a time you were embarrassed.
rows.translation: 描述一次你感到尷尬的經歷。

rows.title: Journey (event/occasion)
rows.text: Describe a journey that didn’t go as planned.
rows.translation: 描述一次不如預期的旅程。

rows.title: Kindness (Person)
rows.text: Describe a person you know who is kind.
rows.translation: 描述一個你認識而且很善良的人。

rows.title: Law
rows.text: Describe a good law.
rows.translation: 描述一條好的法律。

rows.title: Music (object)
rows.text: Describe a song you like.
rows.translation: 描述一首你喜歡的歌。

rows.title: Peaceful Place
rows.text: Describe a place that you find peaceful.
rows.translation: 描述一個你覺得平靜的地方。

rows.title: Relax (activity)
rows.text: Describe something you do to relax.
rows.translation: 描述一件你會做來讓自己放鬆的事情。

rows.title: Respect (person)
rows.text: Describe someone you respect.
rows.translation: 描述一位你尊敬的人。

rows.title: Unexpected (event)
rows.text: Describe an unexpected event.
rows.translation: 描述一件意想不到的事件。

rows.title: Vocation (Object)
rows.text: Describe a vocation you think is useful to society.
rows.translation: 描述一份你認為對社會有用的職業。

rows.title: Water (place)
rows.text: Describe a place near water.
rows.translation: 描述一個靠近水的地方。

rows.title: Zoo (place)
rows.text: Describe a place with animals.
rows.translation: 描述一個有動物的地方。

rows.title: Local Area Change
rows.text: Describe a change that could improve your local area.
rows.translation: 描述一項可以改善你居住地區的改變。

rows.title: Health Article
rows.text: Describe an article you read in a magazine or on the Internet that could help people improve their health.
rows.translation: 描述一篇你在雜誌或網上讀過、可以幫助人改善健康的文章。

rows.title: Public Transport Trip
rows.text: Describe a trip you took by public transport.
rows.translation: 描述一次你乘搭公共交通工具的旅程。

rows.title: Team Member
rows.text: Describe a member of a team that you know about.
rows.translation: 描述一位你認識的隊伍成員。

rows.title: Job You Would Not Like to Do
rows.text: Describe a job you would not like to do.
rows.translation: 描述一份你不想做的工作。

rows.title: Challenge
rows.text: What challenges do young people face today?
rows.translation: 現今年輕人面對甚麼挑戰？

rows.title: Challenge
rows.text: How do young people handle difficult or challenging tasks?
rows.translation: 年輕人通常如何處理困難或具挑戰性的任務？

rows.title: Challenge
rows.text: Which do you think is better, to face these difficulties and challenges alone or to seek the help of others?
rows.translation: 你認為面對這些困難和挑戰時,獨自面對比較好還是尋求他人幫助比較好？

rows.title: Challenge
rows.text: Do you think people need to be challenged?
rows.translation: 你認為人們需要面對挑戰嗎？

rows.title: A Member of A Team
rows.text: In a team, is it more important to pursue individual development or to achieve team targets?
rows.translation: 在團隊中，追求個人發展比較重要，還是達成團隊目標比較重要？

rows.title: A Member of A Team
rows.text: Do you think it’s important for children to join teams to learn to cooperate with others?
rows.translation: 你認為孩子參加團隊去學習與他人合作是否重要？

rows.title: A Member of A Team
rows.text: Do you think disagreements among team members have a great influence on teamwork?
rows.translation: 你認為團隊成員之間的分歧，會對團隊合作有很大的影響嗎？

rows.title: A Member of A Team
rows.text: Can you suggest how teamwork could be cultivated in classes at school?
rows.translation: 你可否建議學校課堂應如何培養團隊合作？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: What are popular types of advertising in today’s world?
rows.translation: 在現今世界，甚麼類型的廣告最受歡迎？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: What type of media advertising do you like most?
rows.translation: 你最喜歡哪一種媒體廣告？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Do you think advertising influences what people buy?
rows.translation: 你認為廣告會影響人們買甚麼嗎？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: What factors should be taken into account when making advertisements?
rows.translation: 製作廣告時，應該考慮哪些因素？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: Is advertising really necessary in modern society?
rows.translation: 在現代社會中，廣告真的有必要嗎？

rows.title: Advertisements
rows.text: How does advertising influence children?
rows.translation: 廣告如何影響孩子？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: Why do people like to keep pets?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們喜歡養寵物？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: What should we do to protect endangered animals?
rows.translation: 我們應該怎樣做去保護瀕危動物？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: Do you support doing experiments on animals?
rows.translation: 你支持在動物身上進行實驗嗎？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: Why do some people refuse to eat animals?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人拒絕吃動物？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: What would happen when some species disappear on earth?
rows.translation: 如果地球上有些物種消失了，會發生甚麼事？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: Do you think that aquatic animals are dangerous?
rows.translation: 你認為水生動物危險嗎？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: A lot of animals are getting extinct these days. What do you think about this? Why is it happening?
rows.translation: 近年有很多動物正在絕種。你對這件事有甚麼看法？為甚麼會發生？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: Earlier people used animals for their work. Now, what do people use to do their work?
rows.translation: 以前人們會用動物來工作。現在，人們用甚麼來做他們的工作？

rows.title: Animals
rows.text: Research is being conducted on animals; is this a good idea?
rows.translation: 在動物身上進行研究，這是一個好主意嗎？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: How do people in your country feel about art?
rows.translation: 你國家的人對藝術有甚麼看法？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: Do people in your country prefer music over art?
rows.translation: 你國家的人是否比起藝術更喜歡音樂？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: What are some traditional art forms in your country?
rows.translation: 傳統藝術形式

rows.title: Art
rows.text: How has art changed in the past few decades in your country?
rows.translation: 在過去幾十年裡，你國家的藝術有甚麼變化？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: Do you think children should study art in school?
rows.translation: 你認為孩子應該在學校學習藝術嗎？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: How can children benefit from learning about art?
rows.translation: 孩子學習藝術可以得到甚麼好處？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: Do you think the government should provide support for art and cultural activities?
rows.translation: 你認為政府應該支持藝術和文化活動嗎？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: How could art exhibitions attract more visitors?
rows.translation: 藝術展覽可以怎樣吸引更多參觀者？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: Are art exhibitions popular in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家的藝術展覽受歡迎嗎？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: Do you think people should have to pay to visit art exhibitions?
rows.translation: 你認為人們參觀藝術展覽是否應該付費？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: How will art exhibitions change in the future?
rows.translation: 未來藝術展覽會怎樣改變？

rows.title: Art
rows.text: What can you do to support an artist?
rows.translation: 你可以做些甚麼去支持一位藝術家？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do people read more nowadays?
rows.translation: 現代人是否比以前讀得更多？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do you read before going to bed?
rows.translation: 你會在睡前閱讀嗎？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: In your opinion, how will e-books affect paper books?
rows.translation: 依你看，電子書將會怎樣影響紙本書？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: What’s the difference between films and books?
rows.translation: 電影和書本有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do you like reading the traditional literature of your country?
rows.translation: 你喜歡閱讀你國家的傳統文學嗎？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do you prefer books or movies?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡書本還是電影？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do you think it is important to read the book before watching the movie version of it?
rows.translation: 你認為在看電影改編版本之前，先讀原著是否重要？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: Do boys and girls like the same kinds of books?
rows.translation: 男孩和女孩喜歡同一類型的書嗎？

rows.title: Books
rows.text: What kind of books do people like to read in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家的人喜歡讀甚麼類型的書？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: In your opinion, do business people have to work long hours?
rows.translation: 你認為商界人士是否必須長時間工作？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: How do business people relax?
rows.translation: 商界人士通常怎樣放鬆？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: How can a small business grow big?
rows.translation: 一間小型企業可以怎樣發展成大企業？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: What kind of small businesses will young people have in the future?
rows.translation: 依你看，年輕人未來會經營甚麼類型的小生意？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: In your opinion, what skills are required to start a small business?
rows.translation: 依你看，開一門小生意需要具備甚麼技能？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: What are the impacts of globalisation on small and large businesses?
rows.translation: 全球化對小型企業和大型企業有甚麼影響？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: What qualities are required to become a company leader (or CEO or manager)?
rows.translation: 要成為公司領袖（例如行政總裁或經理），需要具備甚麼特質？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: In general, what factors do you think determine whether a small company will become successful or not?
rows.translation: 一般來說，你認為甚麼因素會決定一間小公司能否成功？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: Does the latest technology play an important role in a company’s development?
rows.translation: 你認為最新科技在公司的發展中是否扮演重要角色？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: What do you think of charitable organisations?
rows.translation: 你對慈善機構有甚麼看法？

rows.title: Business
rows.text: Which do you think is better, to start your own business or to work for someone else?
rows.translation: 你認為自己創業比較好，還是替別人工作比較好？

rows.title: Change
rows.text: Do you think change is good?
rows.translation: 你認為改變是好事嗎？

rows.title: Change
rows.text: What are some of the major changes that occur to people throughout their lives?
rows.translation: 人們一生之中會經歷哪些重大改變？

rows.title: Change
rows.text: Why do old people not accept change?
rows.translation: 為甚麼年長的人不接受改變？

rows.title: City
rows.text: In your opinion, what makes a city a good one to live in?
rows.translation: 依你看，甚麼會令一座城市成為適合居住的好地方？

rows.title: City
rows.text: What are the advantages of living in a city?
rows.translation: 居住在城市裡有甚麼好處？

rows.title: City
rows.text: In your opinion, what are the negative aspects of crowded cities?
rows.translation: 依你看，擠迫城市有哪些負面之處？

rows.title: City
rows.text: How can governments improve living standards in crowded cities?
rows.translation: 在擠迫的城市裡，政府可以怎樣改善生活質素？

rows.title: City
rows.text: What can people do to improve the air quality in the city?
rows.translation: 在城市裡，人們可以做些甚麼去改善空氣質素？

rows.title: City
rows.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in tall buildings?
rows.translation: 居住在高樓大廈有哪些優點和缺點？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Do you think there will be more tall buildings in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來會有更多高樓大廈嗎？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Why aren’t there many tall buildings in the countryside?
rows.translation: 為甚麼鄉村地區沒有很多高樓大廈？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Why do some people like to live in tall buildings nowadays?
rows.translation: 為甚麼現在有些人喜歡住在高樓大廈裡？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Is it true that tall buildings are more beneficial than small buildings?
rows.translation: 高樓大廈是否真的比小型建築更有好處？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Why do a lot of people enjoy going to crowded places?
rows.translation: 為甚麼很多人喜歡去人多擠迫的地方？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Where (or what) would you say is the most crowded place in your city?
rows.translation: 你會說你城市裡最擠迫的地方是甚麼？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Is it important for a city to have amusement or recreational facilities?
rows.translation: 城市擁有娛樂或康樂設施是否重要？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Why do people choose to live in big cities, despite certain problems?
rows.translation: 你為甚麼認為人們即使面對某些問題，仍然會選擇住在大城市？

rows.title: City
rows.text: How do you think cities overseas are different from those in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為海外城市和你國家的城市有甚麼不同？

rows.title: City
rows.text: Would you say urban planning is important?
rows.translation: 你會說城市規劃重要嗎？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: Can clothing tell you much about a person in your country?
rows.translation: 在我的國家，衣著能看出一個人的很多事情嗎？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: Do people still wear traditional clothing in your country?
rows.translation: 香港人現在還會穿傳統服裝嗎？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: Why do some companies ask their staff to wear uniforms?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些公司會要求員工穿制服？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: How has clothing fashion changed in your country over the last few decades?
rows.translation: 在過去幾十年裡，你國家的服裝時尚有甚麼變化？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of having uniforms at work?
rows.translation: 在工作場合穿制服有甚麼好處和壞處？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: For which jobs are people required to wear a uniform in your country?
rows.translation: 香港有哪些工作需要穿制服？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: Do you think people are treated differently when they are in uniform?
rows.translation: 你認為人們穿上制服時會受到不同對待嗎？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: Where do people from your country buy clothes?
rows.translation: 你國家的人通常在哪裡買衣服？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: What’s the difference between men and women’s choices of clothes?
rows.translation: 男性和女性在衣著選擇上有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: Do clothes affect people’s mood?
rows.translation: 衣服會影響人的心情嗎？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: What do people consider when buying clothes?
rows.translation: 人們買衣服時會考慮甚麼？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: What would you say are the advantages and disadvantages of wearing a uniform?
rows.translation: 穿制服有甚麼好處和壞處？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: What kinds of professionals need to wear uniforms?
rows.translation: 哪些專業人士需要穿制服？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: Do you think people wear clothes that reflect their personality?
rows.translation: 你認為人們穿的衣服會反映他們的性格嗎？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: In your country, do schools provide similar uniforms to their students?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，學校會為學生提供相似的校服嗎？

rows.title: Clothes
rows.text: Do you think women’s clothes show more variety than men’s clothes?
rows.translation: 你認為女性服裝是否比男性服裝更多樣化？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: What is the difference between big companies and small companies?
rows.translation: 大公司和小公司有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: What are the good things about working for a big company?
rows.translation: 在大公司工作有甚麼好處？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: Should big companies be punished more seriously than small companies?
rows.translation: 大公司是否應該比小公司受到更嚴厲的懲罰？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: Are there many big companies in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，有很多大公司嗎？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: Why do some people choose to work at an international company?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人會選擇在國際公司工作？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: Do you think it’s important for a company to provide after-sales service?
rows.translation: 你認為公司提供售後服務重要嗎？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: What are a few things that make you happy?
rows.translation: 甚麼事情會令你感到快樂？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: How can a company maintain the quality of the service that it gives to the public?
rows.translation: 一間公司可以怎樣維持它向公眾提供的服務質素？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: Do you think people who have more talent are happier than others?
rows.translation: 你認為更有天賦的人會比其他人更快樂嗎？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: Does money make people happier?
rows.translation: 金錢會令人更快樂嗎？

rows.title: Company
rows.text: Are the things or events that make people happy today the same as several decades ago?
rows.translation: 今天令人快樂的事物或事情，和幾十年前是一樣的嗎？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: What are the benefits of getting up early?
rows.translation: 早起有甚麼好處？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Why do some people like to stay up late?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人喜歡晚睡？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Do you think it is important to be punctual?
rows.translation: 你認為守時是否重要？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: What kind of situations need people to arrive early?
rows.translation: 甚麼情況下人們需要提早到達？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Why do children and youngsters generally wake up late?
rows.translation: 為甚麼小孩子和年輕人通常都會較遲起床？

rows.title: Daily Routine
rows.text: Do you know anyone who likes to get up early?
rows.translation: 你認識有人喜歡早起嗎？

rows.title: Decision
rows.text: Why do some people find it hard to make decisions?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人會覺得作決定很困難？

rows.title: Decision
rows.text: Why is it sometimes difficult to accept advice?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們有時很難接受別人的建議？

rows.title: Decision
rows.text: How important is it to get advice from other people when making decisions?
rows.translation: 作決定時，聽取別人的意見有多重要？

rows.title: Decision
rows.text: What are some of the most important decisions young people have to make?
rows.translation: 年輕人需要作出哪些最重要的決定？

rows.title: Decision
rows.text: Do you agree that parents should make important decisions for their children?
rows.translation: 你同意父母應該替孩子作重要決定嗎？

rows.title: Decision
rows.text: Is it better to make a decision thinking about what you want or thinking about what other people want?
rows.translation: 做決定時，想自己想要甚麼比較好，還是想別人想要甚麼比較好？

rows.title: Desired Change to Local Area
rows.text: How do people socialise with their neighbours?
rows.translation: 人們通常怎樣和鄰居來往？

rows.title: Eating habits
rows.text: How are the eating habits now in your country different from eating habits in the past?
rows.translation: 你國家現在的飲食習慣，和過去有甚麼不同？

rows.title: Eating habits
rows.text: How healthy is your country’s food?
rows.translation: 你國家的食物有多健康？

rows.title: Eating habits
rows.text: Why do you think different cultures have different table manners?
rows.translation: 你為甚麼認為不同文化會有不同的餐桌禮儀？

rows.title: Eating habits
rows.text: How may eating habits change in the coming decades?
rows.translation: 未來幾十年，飲食習慣可能會怎樣改變？

rows.title: Eating habits
rows.text: Do you think our diet is important?
rows.translation: 你認為我們的飲食重要嗎？

rows.title: Eating habits
rows.text: What is a balanced diet?
rows.translation: 甚麼是均衡飲食？

rows.title: Eating habits
rows.text: How might eating habits change in the coming decades?
rows.translation: 未來幾十年，人們的飲食習慣可能會怎樣改變？

rows.title: Education
rows.text: How are education priorities today different from those in the past?
rows.translation: 今天的教育重點和過去有甚麼不同？

rows.title: Education
rows.text: What is your opinion on the way languages are taught in schools?
rows.translation: 你對學校教授語言的方式有甚麼看法？

rows.title: Education
rows.text: How can the type of school you go to affect career success?
rows.translation: 你就讀的學校類型可以怎樣影響事業成功？

rows.title: Education
rows.text: What changes do you think will happen in the classroom in the near future?
rows.translation: 你認為在不久的將來，課堂會出現甚麼變化？

rows.title: Electronic Devices
rows.text: What are the most popular electronic devices in today’s world?
rows.translation: 在現今世界，最受歡迎的電子設備是甚麼？

rows.title: Electronic Devices
rows.text: What devices do you think will be popular in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來甚麼設備會受歡迎？

rows.title: Electronic Devices
rows.text: Do you think people spend too much money on electronic devices?
rows.translation: 你認為人們在電子產品上花太多錢嗎？

rows.title: Electronic Devices
rows.text: In what ways can electronic devices make our lives harder?
rows.translation: 電子設備可以在哪些方面令我們的生活變得更困難？

rows.title: Electronic Devices
rows.text: What would the world be like without computers?
rows.translation: 如果世界上沒有電腦，會是怎樣的？

rows.title: Electronic Devices
rows.text: Should children be taught to use computers at school?
rows.translation: 孩子是否應該在學校學習使用電腦？

rows.title: Entertainment
rows.text: Do you think traditional performances are important?
rows.translation: 你認為傳統表演重要嗎？

rows.title: Entertainment
rows.text: What do you think is the difference between watching a live performance and watching it on TV?
rows.translation: 你認為現場看表演和在電視上看，有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Entertainment
rows.text: How do you think watching a dance performance or a stage play influences children?
rows.translation: 你認為觀看舞蹈表演或舞台劇會怎樣影響孩子？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: Why should people be concerned about the environment?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們應該關心環境？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: Is water pollution a problem in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為你國家的水污染是一個問題嗎？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: What are some of the main environmental problems in your country?
rows.translation: 你所在的地方有哪些主要環境問題？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: What are some of the causes of water pollution?
rows.translation: 造成水污染的一些原因是甚麼？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: Do you think problems with the cleanliness of water will improve in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來水質清潔方面的問題會改善嗎？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: How can people protect the environment?
rows.translation: 人們可以怎樣保護環境？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: Do you think money should be spent on protecting animals?
rows.translation: 你認為應該花錢保護動物嗎？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: Do you think more should be done to protect natural scenic spots in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為在你的國家，是否應該做更多事情去保護自然風景區？

rows.title: Environment
rows.text: What can individuals do to try and ensure water is kept clean?
rows.translation: 個人可以做些甚麼來盡量確保水源保持清潔？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: What rewards can children get from school?
rows.translation: 孩子可以從學校得到甚麼回報？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: Should parents push their children to get prizes?
rows.translation: 父母應不應該逼孩子去拿獎？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: Is it good for children to compete for prizes at school?
rows.translation: 在學校裡，讓孩子為獎項而競爭是好事嗎？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: What kinds of rewards can companies offer to their outstanding employees?
rows.translation: 公司可以向表現出色的員工提供哪些獎勵？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: Is it good to have competition?
rows.translation: 你認為競爭是好事嗎？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: What are the most common resolutions in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的地方，人們最常見的新年目標是甚麼？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: How difficult would it be for you to save money this year?
rows.translation: 對你來說，今年要存錢會有多困難？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: How difficult would it be for you to get fit this year?
rows.translation: 你覺得自己今年要變得更健康、更有體能，會有多困難？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: What do you think this year will be like for you?
rows.translation: 你覺得今年對你來說會是怎樣的一年？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: Do you personally think that resolutions help us achieve our goals?
rows.translation: 你個人認為，決心能幫助我們達成目標嗎？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: What are the benefits of making New Year’s resolutions?
rows.translation: 新年訂立目標有甚麼好處？

rows.title: Events
rows.text: Describe an event that you attended recently.
rows.translation: 描述一個你最近參加過的活動。

rows.title: Events
rows.text: Describe an important choice you had to make in your life.
rows.translation: 描述你人生中曾經需要作出的一個重要選擇。

rows.title: Events
rows.text: Describe a very difficult task that you succeeded in doing.
rows.translation: 描述一件你成功完成、但非常困難的事。

rows.title: Events
rows.text: Describe an interesting discussion you had related to your work or studies.
rows.translation: 描述一次與你的工作或學業有關、令你覺得有趣的討論。

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: What is it like to be a professional athlete?
rows.translation: 成為一名職業運動員是怎樣的感覺？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: Can you compare some exciting activities people do now with activities people did 20 years ago?
rows.translation: 你可以比較一下現在人們做的一些刺激活動，和二十年前人們做的活動嗎？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: Why do some people enjoy doing dangerous sports?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人喜歡進行危險運動？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: Do you think some dangerous activities should be banned?
rows.translation: 你認為有些危險活動應該被禁止嗎？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: Should people try doing new things?
rows.translation: 人們應該嘗試做新事物嗎？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: What problems can people have when they try new activities for the first time?
rows.translation: 人們第一次嘗試新活動時，可能會遇到甚麼問題？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: Do people in your country spend a lot of money on celebrating birthdays?
rows.translation: 你國家的人會花很多錢慶祝生日嗎？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: Do you think it’s best to do new things on your own or with other people?
rows.translation: 你認為嘗試新事物時，最好自己一個人做，還是和其他人一起做？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: Do you think it’s necessary to spend a lot of money on holding a party?
rows.translation: 你認為辦派對有必要花很多錢嗎？

rows.title: Exciting Experience
rows.text: Do people in your country usually go out to celebrate traditional festivals with others?
rows.translation: 你所在的地方，人們通常會和其他人一起外出慶祝傳統節日嗎？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Is family important in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為在你的國家，家庭重要嗎？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Who should be responsible for caring for the elderly: the family or the government?
rows.translation: 照顧長者的責任應該由誰承擔：家庭還是政府？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: How do you think families will change in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來的家庭會怎樣改變？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: How has the size of the average family changed in your country in the last few decades?
rows.translation: 在過去幾十年裡，你國家的平均家庭規模有甚麼變化？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Should husbands and wives have different roles within the family?
rows.translation: 丈夫和妻子在家庭中應該有不同的角色嗎？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: What role do grandparents play in the family in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，祖父母在家庭中扮演甚麼角色？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: What qualities does a person need to have to take care of old people?
rows.translation: 照顧長者需要具備甚麼特質？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Do you think old people should be taken care of at home?
rows.translation: 你認為長者應該在家中被照顧嗎？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: How can people in the neighbourhood help the elderly during an epidemic?
rows.translation: 鄰里之間的人在疫情期間可以怎樣幫助長者？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Do you see help occurring in your neighbourhood?
rows.translation: 你會在自己的鄰里中看到人們互相幫助嗎？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Do you think teenagers must indulge in building a community for elderly?
rows.translation: 你認為青少年是否必須參與建立一個支持長者的社群？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: What kind of jobs need physical activity?
rows.translation: 哪些工作需要體力活動？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Can physical workers have higher salaries in the future?
rows.translation: 體力勞動工作者在未來有可能有更高薪水嗎？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Do you think machines could replace manual labour in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為在未來，機器可以取代體力勞動嗎？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: How can a person’s energy affect others?
rows.translation: 一個人的氣場或狀態可以怎樣影響別人？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: What’s the difference between payment for physical work and payment for mental work?
rows.translation: 體力勞動和腦力勞動的薪酬有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Do you think children are born smart or do they learn to become smart?
rows.translation: 你認為孩子是天生聰明，還是後天學習才變得聰明？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: How do children become smart at school?
rows.translation: 孩子怎樣才能在學校裡變得聰明、學得好？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Why are some people well-rounded and others only good at one thing?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人很多方面都很全面，而有些人卻只擅長一件事？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Why does modern society need talent of all kinds?
rows.translation: 為甚麼現代社會需要各種不同類型的人才？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: How can we assist youngsters in realising their potential?
rows.translation: 我們可以怎樣幫助年輕人發揮他們的潛能？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Who is the head of the family in your culture?
rows.translation: 在你的文化裡，誰是一家之主？

rows.title: Family / Work (Study) / Potential
rows.text: Are men better at decision-making in a family?
rows.translation: 男人在家庭中是否更擅長作決定？

rows.title: Festival
rows.text: What is the importance of traditional festivals?
rows.translation: 傳統節日有甚麼重要性？

rows.title: Festival
rows.text: What is the difference between festivals that are celebrated now and in the past?
rows.translation: 現在人們慶祝的節日，和過去相比有甚麼不同？

rows.title: Festival
rows.text: Do you think festivals like Christmas are replacing traditional festivals in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為像聖誕節這樣的節日，正在取代你國家的傳統節日嗎？

rows.title: Festival
rows.text: Do you think it is wrong for children not to celebrate traditional festivals?
rows.translation: 你認為孩子不慶祝傳統節日是錯的嗎？

rows.title: Festival
rows.text: Do you think teens should learn about traditions?
rows.translation: 你認為青少年應該學習傳統嗎？

rows.title: Festival
rows.text: Do you think the traditions in your country are restrictive, especially for women in any sense?
rows.translation: 你認為你地方的傳統是否在某些方面具有限制性，特別是對女性而言？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: What are the types of food that people eat in your country?
rows.translation: 主題：你國家的人會吃哪些種類的食物？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: What kinds of foreign food are popular in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家裡，哪些外國菜比較受歡迎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: In your country, is it important to have a meal together with your family?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，和家人一起吃飯重要嗎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Is food now better than in the past?
rows.translation: 食物現在比以前更好嗎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: What kind of people would like to go to a cafe?
rows.translation: 甚麼樣的人會喜歡去咖啡店呢？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Why do young people like studying in a café instead of at home?
rows.translation: 主題：為甚麼年輕人喜歡在咖啡店讀書，而不是在家裡？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Do older people like to drink coffee?
rows.translation: 主題：年長的人喜歡喝咖啡嗎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Do people in your country like to drink coffee?
rows.translation: 香港人喜歡喝咖啡嗎？

rows.title: Food
rows.text: Does the taste of coffee vary by country?
rows.translation: 主題：咖啡的味道會因國家而不同嗎？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Would you like to have a few very good friends or a lot of just friends?
rows.translation: 你會想擁有幾個很好的朋友，還是很多普通朋友？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: If you had a problem, would you go to your friends or family? Why?
rows.translation: 主題：如果你遇到問題，你會去找朋友還是家人？為甚麼？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Do you think it is always better to talk to your friends about such a problem?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為遇到這類問題時，總是和朋友傾談會比較好嗎？

rows.title: Friends
rows.text: Is it important to have friends from other countries?
rows.translation: 擁有來自其他國家的朋友是否重要？

rows.title: Furniture
rows.text: In what situations do people in your country buy furniture?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，人們通常會在甚麼情況下買家具？

rows.title: Furniture
rows.text: In families in your country, who usually decides what furniture to buy for the home?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，家庭通常由誰決定購買甚麼家具？

rows.title: Furniture
rows.text: How do people in your country decide what furniture to buy for the home or office?
rows.translation: 你認為在你的國家，人們會怎樣決定為家居或辦公室購買甚麼家具？（以香港為例）

rows.title: Furniture
rows.text: Do people in your country prefer traditional or modern styles of furniture?
rows.translation: 主題：你地方的人比較喜歡傳統風格的家具，還是現代風格的家具？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Do elderly people exercise much in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家的長者常做運動嗎？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: How can people improve their health?
rows.translation: 主題：人們可以怎樣改善自己的健康？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Do you think all illnesses can be prevented?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為所有疾病都可以被預防嗎？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: What makes someone a good doctor?
rows.translation: 主題：甚麼會令一個人成為好醫生？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Do you think that illnesses will be less common in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來疾病會變得較少見嗎？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Do you think healthcare should be free?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為醫療服務應該免費嗎？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Do you feel that people now are healthier than people in the past?
rows.translation: 你覺得現在的人比以前的人更健康嗎？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Do you think we have to restructure our lifestyle to improve our health?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為我們是否需要重整生活方式，才能改善健康？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: How do you think people could become healthier?
rows.translation: 你認為人們可以怎樣變得更健康？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Are there any differences between the way old people and young people try to stay healthy?
rows.translation: 長者和年輕人保持健康的方式，有沒有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Do schools in your country have any special activities to enhance the fitness of students?
rows.translation: 主題：你地方的學校有沒有一些特別活動去提升學生的體能？

rows.title: Health
rows.text: Do you think people in the future will be doing more exercise and eating healthier than they are today?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為未來的人會比今天的人做更多運動、吃得更健康嗎？

rows.title: Help
rows.text: Do you like helping others?
rows.translation: 你喜歡幫助別人嗎？

rows.title: Help
rows.text: Do you think people are less willing to help others these days compared to the past?
rows.translation: 你認為現代人和過去相比，是否較不願意幫助別人？

rows.title: Help
rows.text: Do people today trust others as much as they used to in the past?
rows.translation: 你覺得今天的人像以前那樣信任別人嗎？

rows.title: Help
rows.text: How do people in your community help each other?
rows.translation: 主題：你所在的社區裡，人們會怎樣互相幫助？

rows.title: Help
rows.text: Let’s move on to the topic of educating children to help people. In your view, should children be taught to help others?
rows.translation: 讓我們轉到教育孩子幫助別人的話題。你認為孩子應該被教導去幫助別人嗎？

rows.title: Help
rows.text: In your opinion, how can we encourage children to help others?
rows.translation: 你認為我們可以怎樣鼓勵孩子幫助別人？

rows.title: Help
rows.text: What about students? How can students, such as high-school students, help each other?
rows.translation: 主題：那麼學生呢？像中學生這樣的學生，可以怎樣互相幫助？

rows.title: History
rows.text: Do you think history is important?
rows.translation: 你認為歷史重要嗎？

rows.title: History
rows.text: Do you like to learn about history?
rows.translation: 你喜歡學習歷史嗎？

rows.title: History
rows.text: What do you think we can learn by studying history?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為透過學習歷史，我們可以學到甚麼？

rows.title: History
rows.text: Let’s move on to different ways of learning about history. In your opinion, how can people learn about history?
rows.translation: 讓我們轉到以不同方式學習歷史的話題。你認為人們可以怎樣了解歷史？

rows.title: History
rows.text: Do you think people can learn history from films or TV programmes?
rows.translation: 你認為人們可以從電影或電視節目中學習歷史嗎？

rows.title: History
rows.text: Do you think the internet is a good place to learn about history?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為互聯網是一個學習歷史的好地方嗎？

rows.title: History
rows.text: What is the effect of technology on how people learn about history?
rows.translation: 科技對人們學習歷史的方式有甚麼影響？

rows.title: Holiday
rows.text: First of all, why do people go on holiday?
rows.translation: 首先，為甚麼人們會去度假？

rows.title: Holiday
rows.text: How important is it for families to go on holiday together?
rows.translation: 家人一起去旅行有多重要？

rows.title: Holiday
rows.text: Why do some people go on holiday alone?
rows.translation: 主題：為甚麼有些人會獨自去旅行？

rows.title: Holiday
rows.text: How have holidays changed over the past few decades?
rows.translation: 過去幾十年來，度假方式有甚麼改變？

rows.title: Holiday
rows.text: What kind of holidays will be popular in the future?
rows.translation: 未來甚麼樣的假期會變得流行？

rows.title: Holiday
rows.text: Do you think it is better to take a holiday in your own country or in a foreign country?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為去本地度假比較好，還是去外國度假比較好？

rows.title: Holiday
rows.text: What problems can people have on holiday in a foreign country?
rows.translation: 人們在外國度假時可能會遇到甚麼問題？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Why do people move to a new home?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們會搬到新家？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: What problems do people face after moving to a new place?
rows.translation: 人們搬到一個新地方之後，會面對甚麼問題？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of living in the same place?
rows.translation: 主題：長期住在同一個地方有甚麼好處和壞處？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Is it good to move to a new place frequently? Why?
rows.translation: 經常搬去新地方住是一件好事嗎？為甚麼？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Do you think it’s better to rent or to buy a place to live in?
rows.translation: 你認為租地方住比較好，還是買地方住比較好？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: How easy is it to find a place to live in your country?
rows.translation: 主題：在你地方，找地方住有多容易？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: Do you agree that there is a right age for young adults to stop living with their parents?
rows.translation: 你是否同意，年輕成年人應該在某個「正確年齡」搬離父母家？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: What are some of the pleasures involved in making a home for ourselves?
rows.translation: 為自己打造一個家，當中有甚麼樂趣？

rows.title: Home
rows.text: What options are available to young couples looking for accommodation in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，年輕夫婦找住處時有甚麼選擇？

rows.title: Influence
rows.text: What types of people influence the young in your country?
rows.translation: 在你國家，哪些類型的人會影響年輕人？

rows.title: Influence
rows.text: What type of people, such as parents, teachers, or friends, are best to influence young people’s behaviour?
rows.translation: 像父母、老師或朋友這類人當中，哪一類最適合影響年輕人的行為？

rows.title: Influence
rows.text: Why is it important for young people to have role models?
rows.translation: 為甚麼年輕人有榜樣是重要的？

rows.title: Influence
rows.text: What do you think young people will be influenced by the most in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來年輕人最受甚麼影響？

rows.title: Influence
rows.text: Why is it important to have role models?
rows.translation: 為甚麼擁有榜樣是重要的？

rows.title: Influence
rows.text: Do you think the education system in your country influences young people’s behaviour?
rows.translation: 你認為你國家的教育制度會影響年輕人的行為嗎？

rows.title: Influence
rows.text: What type of person, such as parents, teachers, or friends, is best at influencing young people’s behaviour?
rows.translation: 主題：像父母、老師或朋友這些人之中，哪一類人最能影響年輕人的行為？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: How do you think the Internet will change people’s buying habits in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為互聯網將來會怎樣改變人們的購物習慣？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: What are the pros and cons of shopping online?
rows.translation: 網上購物有甚麼好處和壞處？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: Is the Internet important for education?
rows.translation: 主題：互聯網對教育重要嗎？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: Do you think parents should supervise their children’s use of the Internet?
rows.translation: 你認為父母應該監管孩子使用網絡嗎？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: What’s the best age for children to use the Internet?
rows.translation: 你認為孩子幾歲開始使用互聯網是最合適的？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: Why do children start using the Internet very early nowadays?
rows.translation: 主題：為甚麼現在的孩子很早就開始使用互聯網？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: Let’s move on to what people do on the Internet. What do you think people do on the Internet?
rows.translation: 我們來談談人們在互聯網上做甚麼。你認為人們會在網上做些甚麼？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: What can people do on social media?
rows.translation: 人們可以在社交媒體上做些甚麼？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: What about elderly people? Do elderly people use the Internet very much?
rows.translation: 那長者呢？長者會很常用互聯網嗎？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: Do you think older people and younger people will use the same kind of social media software?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為年長人士和年輕人將來會使用同一類社交媒體軟件嗎？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: Are traditional media like television and newspapers still useful?
rows.translation: 像電視和報紙這類傳統媒體仍然有用嗎？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: What are the advantages and disadvantages of using social media?
rows.translation: 主題：使用社交媒體有甚麼優點和缺點？

rows.title: Internet
rows.text: Do older people spend much time on social media?
rows.translation: 長者會花很多時間在社交媒體上嗎？

rows.title: Job
rows.text: How do you think AI (artificial intelligence) will affect people’s work?
rows.translation: 你認為人工智能會怎樣影響人們的工作？

rows.title: Job
rows.text: What would you say are the important factors to consider when choosing a career?
rows.translation: 你會說選擇職業時需要考慮哪些重要因素？

rows.title: Job
rows.text: Technology will make some people lose their jobs. How do you think this problem should be handled?
rows.translation: 科技會令一些人失去工作。你認為這個問題應該怎樣處理？

rows.title: Job
rows.text: Would you ever move to work and live in another city?
rows.translation: 你會搬到另一個城市工作和生活嗎？

rows.title: Job
rows.text: Is it common in your country for people to move to other cities because of work?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，人們因為工作而搬到其他城市是常見的嗎？（以香港為例）

rows.title: Job
rows.text: When young people choose their jobs, which is usually more important, the salary or their interest in the work?
rows.translation: 當年輕人選擇工作時，通常是薪水比較重要，還是對工作的興趣比較重要？

rows.title: Leadership
rows.text: How do you see leadership qualities now and in the future?
rows.translation: 主題：你怎樣看現在以及未來的領導特質？

rows.title: Leadership
rows.text: Do you think that in the future there will be more women leaders?
rows.translation: 你認為未來會有更多女性領袖嗎？

rows.title: Leadership
rows.text: What are the advantages of strong family relationships?
rows.translation: 牢固的家庭關係有甚麼好處？

rows.title: Leadership
rows.text: Should a leader discuss with team members when making decisions?
rows.translation: 領導者在作決定時，是否應該和團隊成員商量？

rows.title: Leadership
rows.text: How many generations are usually living under one roof in your country?
rows.translation: 主題：在你的國家，通常有多少代人會住在同一屋簷下？

rows.title: Leadership
rows.text: What are the benefits and drawbacks of a family of several generations living together?
rows.translation: 幾代同堂的家庭有甚麼好處和壞處？

rows.title: Leadership
rows.text: Do both parents have equal responsibilities in taking care of their children?
rows.translation: 你認為父母雙方在照顧孩子方面是否有同等責任？

rows.title: Late
rows.text: What is the general attitude towards arriving somewhere late in your country?
rows.translation: 在你國家，對於遲到的整體看法是怎樣的？

rows.title: Late
rows.text: What is an example of a time when it is very important for people to arrive on time in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，有甚麼情況是人們一定要準時到達的？

rows.title: Late
rows.text: Can you suggest some ways to make sure you are not late for anything?
rows.translation: 你可以建議一些方法，確保自己不會遲到嗎？

rows.title: Late
rows.text: Let’s move on to how modern technology influences the way that people manage time. Do you think computers make it easier or more difficult to manage time?
rows.translation: 讓我們轉到現代科技如何影響人們管理時間的方式。你認為電腦令時間管理變得更容易，還是更困難？

rows.title: Late
rows.text: How can modern technology help people arrive early?
rows.translation: 現代科技可以怎樣幫助人們提早到達？

rows.title: Late
