rows.text: Do you think it is easy to manage your time in the modern world?
rows.translation: 你認為在現代世界裡，管理時間容易嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: What types of leisure activities are popular in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，哪些休閒活動很受歡迎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Why is it important for people to have time for leisure activities?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們有時間做休閒活動是很重要的？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Why are some activities more popular than others?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些活動比其他活動更受歡迎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Are the types of leisure activities that are popular today the same as those that were popular when your parents were young?
rows.translation: 今天流行的休閒活動，和你父母年輕時流行的一樣嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: What types of leisure activities may become more popular in the future?
rows.translation: 未來哪些類型的休閒活動可能會變得更受歡迎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Do you think watching films has any educational benefits?
rows.translation: 你認為看電影有教育上的好處嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: In what ways are documentary films and films made purely for entertainment different?
rows.translation: 紀錄片和純粹為娛樂而製作的電影，有哪些方面不同？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Why do you think documentary films are not so popular?
rows.translation: 你為甚麼認為紀錄片沒有那麼受歡迎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: How are movies and real life different?
rows.translation: 電影和現實生活有甚麼不同？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Do men and women watch the same kind of films?
rows.translation: 男人和女人會看同一類型的電影嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Do you like any particular film star?
rows.translation: 你有特別喜歡哪位電影明星嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Do different age groups like the same kind of films?
rows.translation: 不同年齡層喜歡同一類電影嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Do you like movie stars who are treated like gods?
rows.translation: 你喜歡那些被人像神一樣崇拜的電影明星嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Do you like any particular film star?
rows.translation: 你有特別喜歡哪位電影明星嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Do you like movie stars who are treated like gods?
rows.translation: 你喜歡那些被人像神一樣崇拜的電影明星嗎？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Which do you think is better, a detective movie or its original novel?
rows.translation: 你認為哪一個比較好：偵探電影，還是它原本的小說？

rows.title: Leisure Activities
rows.text: Why are detective stories attractive to people?
rows.translation: 為甚麼偵探故事對人們有吸引力？

rows.title: Machine
rows.text: What kinds of machines are used for housework in modern homes in your country?
rows.translation: 在你地方，現代家庭通常會用哪些機器來做家務？

rows.title: Machine
rows.text: How have the machines that are used for housework in modern homes benefited people? Are there any negative effects of using them?
rows.translation: 現代家庭中用來做家務的機器怎樣使人受益？使用它們有沒有負面影響？

rows.title: Machine
rows.text: Do you think all new homes will be equipped with household machines in the future? Why?
rows.translation: 你認為未來所有新住宅都會配備家用機器嗎？為甚麼？

rows.title: Machine
rows.text: Do you think people rely too much on technology?
rows.translation: 你認為人們是否太依賴科技？

rows.title: Machine
rows.text: Do you think men and women view technology differently?
rows.translation: 你認為男人和女人看待科技的方式不同嗎？

rows.title: Machine
rows.text: Finally, let’s talk about the impact of technology on employment. How have developments in technology affected employment in your country?
rows.translation: 最後，讓我們談談科技對就業的影響。科技發展如何影響了你所在地方的就業情況？

rows.title: Machine
rows.text: Some people think that technology has brought more stress than benefits to employed people nowadays. Do you agree or disagree?
rows.translation: 你是否同意，有些人認為科技對現今受僱人士帶來的壓力多於好處？

rows.title: Memory
rows.text: Do you think it’s important to have a good memory?
rows.translation: 你認為擁有好的記憶力重要嗎？

rows.title: Memory
rows.text: Why do people sometimes forget things?
rows.translation: 人們為甚麼有時會忘記事情？

rows.title: Memory
rows.text: Which do you think is more important to remember, a business meeting or a meeting with a friend?
rows.translation: 你認為比較重要要記住的，是商務會議，還是和朋友的約會？

rows.title: Memory
rows.text: Are there any things that are especially important for people to memorise?
rows.translation: 有沒有一些事情是人們特別應該記在腦裡的？

rows.title: Memory
rows.text: Why do people want to remember their family history?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們想記住自己的家族歷史？

rows.title: Memory
rows.text: What can you do to learn more about your family history?
rows.translation: 你可以怎樣更了解自己的家族歷史？

rows.title: Mobile Phone
rows.text: Do you think there should be regulations on the use of mobile phones?
rows.translation: 你認為手機的使用應該受到規管嗎？

rows.title: Mobile Phone
rows.text: What do you think of primary school students owning a mobile phone?
rows.translation: 你怎樣看待小學生擁有手機這件事？

rows.title: Mobile Phone
rows.text: What (minimum) age do you think is appropriate for owning a cell phone?
rows.translation: 你認為擁有手機的最低合適年齡是多少？

rows.title: Money
rows.text: Is money important to you?
rows.translation: 金錢對你來說重要嗎？

rows.title: Money
rows.text: What is the relationship between money and power?
rows.translation: 金錢和權力之間有甚麼關係？

rows.title: Money
rows.text: How do you think parents can teach the value of money to their children?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為父母可以怎樣教孩子金錢的價值？

rows.title: Money
rows.text: Do you think it is important to teach children money skills?
rows.translation: 你認為教孩子理財能力重要嗎？

rows.title: Money
rows.text: Should we let children buy whatever they want with money they’ve saved?
rows.translation: 我們是否應該讓孩子用自己存下來的錢買任何他們想買的東西？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: What kind of music is popular in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家流行甚麼類型的音樂？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: How does pop music now compare to when you were growing up?
rows.translation: 你成長時期的流行音樂，和現在的流行音樂相比，有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: Do you think it is necessary for the government to require all children to learn music?
rows.translation: 你認為政府有必要規定所有孩子都學音樂嗎？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: Do you think the government needs to do more to preserve traditional music? What could they do?
rows.translation: 你認為政府是否需要做更多去保存傳統音樂？他們可以做些甚麼？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: There’s a lot of pirated music. Do you agree that we should support official music?
rows.translation: 主題：現在有很多盜版音樂。你是否同意我們應該支持正版音樂？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: What are some possible advantages and disadvantages of being stricter about the illegal downloading of music?
rows.translation: 對非法下載音樂採取更嚴格措施，可能有甚麼好處和壞處？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: Is foreign music or music from your country more popular with people your age?
rows.translation: 主題：對我這個年齡層的人來說，外國音樂還是本地音樂更受歡迎？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: Do singers play an important role in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，歌手扮演重要角色嗎？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: Do you think celebrities have a lot of income?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為名人收入很多嗎？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: Do you think CDs will have any role in the music industry in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來 CD 在音樂產業裡還會有角色嗎？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: In your country, do people prefer to listen to traditional music or foreign music?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，人們比較喜歡聽傳統音樂，還是外國音樂？（以香港為例）

rows.title: Music
rows.text: Do you prefer live performances?
rows.translation: 你比較喜歡現場表演嗎？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: What do you think about the role of singers at the national level?
rows.translation: 主題：你怎樣看歌手在國家層面上的角色？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: Why do you think pop music is so popular?
rows.translation: 你為甚麼認為流行音樂這麼受歡迎？

rows.title: Music
rows.text: What types of songs are the most popular among today’s young generation in Hong Kong?
rows.translation: 在今天的香港年輕一代之中，哪類歌曲最受歡迎？

rows.title: News
rows.text: How do people get their news in today’s society?
rows.translation: 在今天的社會裡，人們通常怎樣獲取新聞？

rows.title: News
rows.text: How do you think people will get their news in the future?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為未來人們會怎樣獲取新聞？

rows.title: News
rows.text: How does modern technology affect the delivery of news?
rows.translation: 現代科技如何影響新聞的傳遞方式？

rows.title: News
rows.text: Do you believe everything you read in the newspaper?
rows.translation: 你會相信報紙上讀到的每一件事嗎？

rows.title: News
rows.text: In your opinion, when do people share good news?
rows.translation: 主題：依你看，人們通常會在甚麼時候分享好消息？

rows.title: News
rows.text: How do people share good news?
rows.translation: 人們通常怎樣分享好消息？

rows.title: News
rows.text: What is the difference between new media and old media?
rows.translation: 新媒體和傳統媒體有甚麼分別？

rows.title: News
rows.text: Do you think the contents in the newspapers are reliable?
rows.translation: 你認為報紙裡的內容可靠嗎？

rows.title: News
rows.text: Do you think it’s necessary for people to watch foreign news?
rows.translation: 主題：你認為人們有必要看外國新聞嗎？

rows.title: News
rows.text: How has social media changed how we consume news?
rows.translation: 社交媒體如何改變了我們接收新聞的方式？

rows.title: News
rows.text: What kinds of famous people are usually in the news in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家裡，哪一類知名人士通常最常出現在新聞裡？

rows.title: Parenting
rows.text: For parents, what is important when bringing up their children?
rows.translation: 對父母來說，在養育孩子時，甚麼是重要的？

rows.title: Parenting
rows.text: Do you think mothers and fathers have different roles to play in bringing up a child?
rows.translation: 你認為母親和父親在養育孩子方面扮演的角色是否不同？

rows.title: Parenting
rows.text: Do you think hitting children is sometimes necessary for discipline?
rows.translation: 你認為為了管教孩子，有時候打他們是有必要的嗎？

rows.title: Parenting
rows.text: Do you think sweets are a good thing to reward children with?
rows.translation: 你認為用糖果或甜食來獎勵小朋友是好事嗎？

rows.title: Parenting
rows.text: Do you think parents spend too much on buying toys for their children?
rows.translation: 你認為父母在為孩子買玩具這方面花得太多嗎？

rows.title: Party
rows.text: When do people usually have parties in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，人們通常會在甚麼時候開派對？

rows.title: Party
rows.text: What makes a good party?
rows.translation: 甚麼才算是一個好的派對？

rows.title: Party
rows.text: What are the main reasons why people organise family parties in your country?
rows.translation: 在你地方，人們舉辦家庭聚會的主要原因是甚麼？

rows.title: Party
rows.text: In some places people spend a lot of money on parties that celebrate special family events. Is this ever true in your country? Do you think this is a good trend or a bad trend?
rows.translation: 有些地方的人會花很多錢去舉辦慶祝家庭特別事件的派對。這種情況在你的國家存在嗎？你認為這是好趨勢還是壞趨勢？

rows.title: Party
rows.text: Why do some people think that national celebrations are a waste of government money? Do you agree or disagree with this view? Why?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人認為國家慶祝活動是在浪費政府金錢？你同意還是不同意這個看法？為甚麼？

rows.title: Party
rows.text: How important is it to celebrate important events with a group of people?
rows.translation: 和一群人一起慶祝重要時刻有多重要？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What decisions do people generally make in their daily life?
rows.translation: 人們在日常生活中一般會作出哪些決定？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Which is easier, making a decision by oneself or making a decision after a group discussion?
rows.translation: 自己作決定比較容易，還是在小組討論後作決定比較容易？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Why are many young people unwilling to listen to their parents’ advice?
rows.translation: 為甚麼很多年輕人不願意聽父母的建議？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Why do middle-aged people tend to second-guess their decisions?
rows.translation: 為甚麼中年人往往會反覆懷疑自己的決定？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Should people consider the consequences of their decisions that impact others, or only think of themselves?
rows.translation: 人們在作出會影響別人的決定時，應該考慮後果，還是只需要想到自己？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Do you think adults can have lots of imagination?
rows.translation: 你認為成年人可以有很多想像力嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Do you think imagination is necessary for scientists?
rows.translation: 你認為科學家需要想像力嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What kind of jobs need imagination?
rows.translation: 哪些工作需要想像力？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What subjects are helpful for people’s imagination?
rows.translation: 哪些科目有助培養人的想像力？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Do you think children can have a strong imagination?
rows.translation: 你認為孩子可以擁有很強的想像力嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Do children like to change opinions?
rows.translation: 孩子喜歡改變自己的看法嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Why do people change their opinion?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們會改變自己的看法？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Who do young people turn to for advice?
rows.translation: 年輕人通常會向誰尋求意見？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Do people like giving an opinion about politics?
rows.translation: 人們喜歡對政治發表意見嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Is changing opinions good for society?
rows.translation: 改變意見對社會有好處嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: On what occasions do people usually need to wait?
rows.translation: 在甚麼情況下，人們通常需要等候？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Who behaves better when waiting, children or adults?
rows.translation: 等待時，孩子和成年人誰表現得比較好？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Compared to the past, are people less patient now? Why?
rows.translation: 和過去相比，現在的人是不是比較沒有耐性？為甚麼？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What are the positive and negative effects of waiting on society?
rows.translation: 等待這件事，對社會有甚麼正面和負面影響？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Are you a patient person?
rows.translation: 你是一個有耐性的人嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Do you think it is possible to teach people to be more patient?
rows.translation: 你認為人是可以被教得更有耐性嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Some people believe that impatience helps the development of technology. Do you agree with that? Why do you think so?
rows.translation: 有些人認為，不耐煩有助於科技發展。你同意嗎？為甚麼？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Where do you go to get good advice?
rows.translation: 你通常會去找誰，或者去甚麼地方尋求好的建議？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Whose advice do you follow more, your parents’ or your friends’ advice?
rows.translation: 你通常比較會聽誰的建議，父母還是朋友？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Have your parents given you much advice?
rows.translation: 你父母有給你很多意見嗎？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What kind of advice do parents give their children?
rows.translation: 父母通常會給孩子甚麼樣的建議？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What kind of advice do friends give each other?
rows.translation: 朋友之間通常會給彼此甚麼樣的建議？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What can we learn from our mistakes?
rows.translation: 我們能從錯誤中學到甚麼？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: Do children make mistakes easily?
rows.translation: 小孩子是否很容易犯錯？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What do children learn from teachers and parents?
rows.translation: 孩子會從老師和父母身上學到甚麼？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: What should parents do if their children make mistakes?
rows.translation: 如果孩子犯錯，父母應該怎樣做？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: How should a person be remorseful for their mistakes?
rows.translation: 一個人應該怎樣為自己的錯誤感到悔意，並表現出悔意？

rows.title: Personal / Qualities
rows.text: How do children benefit from using dictionaries?
rows.translation: 孩子使用字典有甚麼好處？

rows.title: Plans
rows.text: In general, do you think planning is important?
rows.translation: 整體來說，你認為計劃重要嗎？

rows.title: Plans
rows.text: Do you think people should make highly detailed plans or just general plans?
rows.translation: 你認為人們應該制定非常詳細的計劃，還是只制定大方向的計劃？

rows.title: Plans
rows.text: What types of people like to make plans?
rows.translation: 甚麼類型的人喜歡做計劃？

rows.title: Plans
rows.text: Why do you think some people dislike making plans?
rows.translation: 你認為為甚麼有些人不喜歡做計劃？

rows.title: Plans
rows.text: Do you think it’s important for a person to have a career plan?
rows.translation: 你認為一個人擁有職業規劃重要嗎？

rows.title: Plans
rows.text: How do most people plan their futures in their education and careers?
rows.translation: 人們通常怎樣規劃自己在教育和事業上的未來？

rows.title: Plans
rows.text: Do you think it’s important for young people to get advice from their parents when planning a career?
rows.translation: 你認為年輕人在規劃職業時，向父母請教是否重要？

rows.title: Products
rows.text: What kinds of products are mostly imported into your country?
rows.translation: 你國家主要進口哪些類型的產品？

rows.title: Products
rows.text: In your opinion, why do some people like to buy imported products?
rows.translation: 你認為為甚麼有些人喜歡購買進口產品？

rows.title: Products
rows.text: What are some famous local products in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家有甚麼著名的本地產品？

rows.title: Products
rows.text: Do you think a country should make everything it needs or import some things?
rows.translation: 你認為一個國家應該把自己需要的東西全部都自己生產，還是應該進口一部分？

rows.title: Products
rows.text: What are the disadvantages of a country producing everything it needs?
rows.translation: 一個國家如果嘗試生產自己所需要的一切，會有甚麼壞處？

rows.title: Products
rows.text: Do you think the globalisation of industries and commerce is a good thing?
rows.translation: 你認為產業和商業全球化是一件好事嗎？

rows.title: Products
rows.text: What are the impacts of globalisation on international trade?
rows.translation: 全球化對國際貿易有甚麼影響？

rows.title: Restaurant
rows.text: Why do some people enjoy eating out?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人喜歡外出用餐？

rows.title: Restaurant
rows.text: Nowadays, more and more people are unwilling to cook. Why is this happening?
rows.translation: 現在愈來愈多人不願意下廚。為甚麼會這樣？

rows.title: Restaurant
rows.text: Do many people eat in restaurants in your country?
rows.translation: 在你國家，很多人會在餐廳吃飯嗎？

rows.title: Restaurant
rows.text: Is it expensive to eat out in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，外出吃飯貴嗎？

rows.title: Restaurant
rows.text: Do you like to cook at home?
rows.translation: 你喜歡在家煮飯嗎？

rows.title: Restaurant
rows.text: What’s the difference between restaurant food and home-cooked food?
rows.translation: 餐廳食物和家常菜有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Reading
rows.text: What type of magazines do teens prefer to read?
rows.translation: 青少年較喜歡看哪一類雜誌？

rows.title: Reading
rows.text: Why is it that different people want to see different magazines?
rows.translation: 為甚麼不同的人會想看不同種類的雜誌？

rows.title: Reading
rows.text: What is the distinction between information on TV and information in magazines?
rows.translation: 電視上的資訊和雜誌裡的資訊有甚麼分別？

rows.title: Reading
rows.text: Do folks like to read the information on the World Wide Web?
rows.translation: 人們喜歡閱讀萬維網上的資訊嗎？

rows.title: Reading
rows.text: Do people still purchase magazines in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，人們現在還會買雜誌嗎？

rows.title: Rules
rows.text: Why do we have rules in society?
rows.translation: 為甚麼社會裡會有規則？

rows.title: Rules
rows.text: Do you think it’s necessary to set up rules about overworking people?
rows.translation: 你認為有必要訂立規則去防止人們過度工作嗎？

rows.title: Rules
rows.text: What are some examples of rules that exist in many families?
rows.translation: 在很多家庭裡，常見的家庭規矩有哪些？

rows.title: Rules
rows.text: What are some rules that exist in schools or workplaces in your country?
rows.translation: 在你地方，學校或工作場所裡有哪些規則？

rows.title: Rules
rows.text: Do you think that the students themselves should have a say in what kinds of school rules there are?
rows.translation: 你認為學生自己應不應該對學校應有哪些規則有發言權？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: Should all students pay for their university education?
rows.translation: 所有學生都應該為自己的大學教育付費嗎？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: Can you compare the education your parents had with the education that you received?
rows.translation: 你可以比較一下你父母接受的教育和你自己接受的教育嗎？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: What changes do you think will happen in the classrooms of the near future?
rows.translation: 你認為在不久的將來，課室裡會出現甚麼改變？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: What advantages do universities bring to society?
rows.translation: 大學會為社會帶來甚麼好處？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: Which is more important, research or teaching?
rows.translation: 研究和教學，哪一樣比較重要？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: What makes a good university student?
rows.translation: 甚麼特質會讓一個人成為好的大學生？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: Is higher education too expensive in your country?
rows.translation: 在你國家，高等教育是不是太昂貴了？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: Do you think students should be taken to school by their parents or go by themselves?
rows.translation: 你認為學生應該由父母送去上學，還是自己去比較好？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: Should children rely on their parents or be independent?
rows.translation: 孩子應該依賴父母，還是應該獨立？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: How can children become more independent?
rows.translation: 孩子可以怎樣變得更獨立？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: What is the effect if parents interfere with children’s life too much?
rows.translation: 如果父母過度干涉孩子的生活，會有甚麼影響？

rows.title: Schools
rows.text: How does changing school affect children?
rows.translation: 轉校會怎樣影響孩子？

rows.title: Science
rows.text: Do you think science is important?
rows.translation: 你認為科學重要嗎？

rows.title: Science
rows.text: Do you think science can change our society?
rows.translation: 你認為科學可以改變我們的社會嗎？

rows.title: Science
rows.text: Why do you think some inventions have not been successful in the marketplace?
rows.translation: 你認為為甚麼有些發明在市場上沒有成功？

rows.title: Science
rows.text: Do you think it’s good that new inventions are appearing so often?
rows.translation: 你認為新發明這麼頻繁地出現是一件好事嗎？

rows.title: Science
rows.text: Which area of science has been the most important in the last one hundred years?
rows.translation: 在過去一百年裡，你認為哪一個科學領域最重要？

rows.title: Science
rows.text: Do you think there will be any negative effects resulting from future technology?
rows.translation: 你認為未來科技會帶來任何負面影響嗎？

rows.title: Science
rows.text: Do you think there will be any negative effects resulting from future technology?
rows.translation: 你認為未來科技會帶來任何負面影響嗎？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: Is shopping a popular activity in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為在你的國家，購物是一項受歡迎的活動嗎？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: How have shopping habits changed over recent years?
rows.translation: 近年來，人們的購物習慣有甚麼改變？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: To what extent do you think advertising affects the way people shop?
rows.translation: 你認為廣告在多大程度上影響人們的購物方式？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: Do you think shopping habits are likely to change in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來人們的購物習慣有可能改變嗎？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: Why do some people prefer to purchase brand name products produced abroad?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人較喜歡購買在外國生產的名牌產品？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: Is service better in large shops or in small shops?
rows.translation: 大型商店的服務比較好，還是小店的服務比較好？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: What do people do when they get bad service?
rows.translation: 當人們遇到服務差的情況時，通常會怎樣做？

rows.title: School Problems
rows.text: What can be done to alleviate poverty?
rows.translation: 可以做些甚麼來減輕貧窮問題？

rows.title: School Problems
rows.text: Are there many charities in your country?
rows.translation: 你的國家有很多慈善機構嗎？

rows.title: School Problems
rows.text: What social problems are there in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為你的國家有哪些社會問題？

rows.title: School Problems
rows.text: Let’s move on to talk about the overpopulation problem. Why do so many people move to live in cities?
rows.translation: 我們來談談人口過多的問題。為甚麼那麼多人搬到城市居住？

rows.title: School Problems
rows.text: What problems does overpopulation cause?
rows.translation: 人口過多會帶來甚麼問題？

rows.title: School Problems
rows.text: What can be done to alleviate poverty?
rows.translation: 可以做些甚麼來減輕貧窮問題？

rows.title: School Problems
rows.text: What is the difference between major and minor crime?
rows.translation: 重大罪行和輕微罪行有甚麼分別？

rows.title: School Problems
rows.text: Do you think all criminals should go to prison?
rows.translation: 你認為所有罪犯都應該入獄嗎？

rows.title: Something Difficult to Use
rows.text: Do you often buy new things?
rows.translation: 你經常買新東西嗎？

rows.title: Something Difficult to Use
rows.text: Would you say that advertising makes people buy more new things than they would if there was no advertising?
rows.translation: 你會不會說，如果沒有廣告，人們就不會買那麼多新東西？

rows.title: Something Difficult to Use
rows.text: Do older people have difficulties using some things that young people do not?
rows.translation: 你認為長者在使用某些東西時，會比年輕人更容易遇到困難嗎？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: What types of sports are popular in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，哪些運動比較受歡迎？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: Do you think the types of sports that are popular will change in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來受歡迎的運動種類會改變嗎？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: In your opinion, what are the benefits of playing a sport?
rows.translation: 依你看，參與運動有甚麼好處？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: What about cultural aspects? How can sports bring people from different countries closer together?
rows.translation: 從文化層面來看，運動可以怎樣把不同國家的人拉得更近？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: Do you think old people can keep fit by playing sports or exercising?
rows.translation: 你認為老人家可以靠做運動或鍛鍊來保持健康嗎？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: Why would somebody dislike watching the Olympic Games?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人會不喜歡看奧運會？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: How are Olympic players trained in your country? Do they usually start training when they are born?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，奧運選手通常是怎樣訓練出來的？他們會不會一出生就開始受訓？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: Do you think the types of sport that are popular will change in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來受歡迎的運動類型會改變嗎？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: Why do parents let their children play with puzzles?
rows.translation: 為甚麼父母會讓孩子玩拼圖或益智遊戲？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: What kind of puzzles improve people’s intelligence?
rows.translation: 甚麼類型的謎題能提升人的智力？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: Which age group plays puzzles the most?
rows.translation: 哪一個年齡層最常玩拼圖或解謎遊戲？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: What kinds of exercises do people in your country like?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，人們喜歡做甚麼運動？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: What characteristics do you think an athlete should have?
rows.translation: 你認為一位運動員應該具備甚麼特質？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: Why are there so few top athletes?
rows.translation: 為甚麼頂尖運動員這麼少？

rows.title: Sports
rows.text: What’s the best way to become a top athlete?
rows.translation: 成為頂尖運動員最好的方法是甚麼？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: How often do people go to buy clothes?
rows.translation: 人們通常多久會去買一次衣服？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: What are your thoughts about the trend that people buy new things instead of repairing the old ones?
rows.translation: 對於人們寧願買新的東西，也不修理舊東西這個趨勢，你有甚麼看法？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: Is increasing consumerism a good trend?
rows.translation: 消費主義不斷增加，算不算是一個好的趨勢？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: Do you think adults’ and youngsters’ shopping lists are very different?
rows.translation: 你認為成年人和年輕人的購物清單差別很大嗎？

rows.title: Shopping
rows.text: Which products are most consumed in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，哪些產品消耗得最多？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: What skills should students master?
rows.translation: 學生應該掌握哪些技能？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: Is it hard for students to learn new skills?
rows.translation: 學生學習新技能困難嗎？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: Is it hard for old people to learn new skills?
rows.translation: 年長的人學習新技能會很困難嗎？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: Is a good teacher very important for students’ learning experience? Why?
rows.translation: 一位好老師對學生的學習體驗是不是非常重要？為甚麼？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: What is necessary to learn and improve a skill?
rows.translation: 學習並提升一項技能，需要甚麼？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: Why do some people have a better memory?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人記性比較好？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: Which can help people remember things better, words or photos?
rows.translation: 哪一種更能幫助人記住東西，文字還是照片？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: Can technology help people remember things better? How?
rows.translation: 科技可以幫助人們更好地記住事情嗎？可以的話，是怎樣幫助的？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: How can people improve their memory?
rows.translation: 人們可以怎樣改善記憶力？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: Should old people read books?
rows.translation: 年長的人應該閱讀書籍嗎？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: What is the most important practical skill in modern society?
rows.translation: 在現代社會裡，最重要的實用技能是甚麼？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: What kind of job requires practical skills?
rows.translation: 甚麼類型的工作需要實際技能？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: What kinds of skills are difficult to learn?
rows.translation: 甚麼類型的技能比較難學？

rows.title: Study
rows.text: How can you teach your skills to others?
rows.translation: 你可以怎樣把自己的技能教給別人？

rows.title: Teacher
rows.text: How well-respected are teachers in your society?
rows.translation: 在你的社會裡，老師受到多大程度的尊重？

rows.title: Teacher
rows.text: Do you think teachers get paid enough money in your country?
rows.translation: 你認為在你地方，老師的薪酬足夠嗎？

rows.title: Teacher
rows.text: What role should the teacher have in the classroom?
rows.translation: 老師在課堂上應該扮演甚麼角色？

rows.title: Teacher
rows.text: In your opinion, what are the most important qualities for a good teacher to have?
rows.translation: 在你看來，一位好老師最重要應具備哪些特質？

rows.title: Teacher
rows.text: In your opinion, how can a teacher make lessons for children more interesting?
rows.translation: 你認為老師可以怎樣令孩子的課堂變得更有趣？

rows.title: Teacher
rows.text: Do you think computers will one day replace teachers in the classroom?
rows.translation: 你認為將來電腦有一天會在課堂上取代老師嗎？

rows.title: Technology
rows.text: What’s the best invention in the past hundred years?
rows.translation: 在過去一百年裡，最好的發明是甚麼？

rows.title: Technology
rows.text: What’s the influence of science on human life?
rows.translation: 科學對人類生活有甚麼影響？

rows.title: Technology
rows.text: What can individuals do for scientific research?
rows.translation: 個人可以為科學研究做些甚麼？

rows.title: Technology
rows.text: What influence can international cooperation in science bring about?
rows.translation: 國際科學合作可以帶來甚麼影響？

rows.title: Technology
rows.text: Do you think it is mandatory to teach science in schools?
rows.translation: 你認為學校是否必須教授科學？

rows.title: Text Message
rows.text: Why do some people dislike using text messages?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人不喜歡用文字訊息溝通？

rows.title: Text Message
rows.text: Have the ways that people communicated with each other changed much in the last few decades?
rows.translation: 在過去幾十年裡，人們彼此溝通的方式有很大改變嗎？

rows.title: Text Message
rows.text: Why do people prefer texting as compared to phone calls?
rows.translation: 為甚麼人們比起打電話，更喜歡傳訊息？

rows.title: Text Message
rows.text: Do you think modern technology has any negative influence on communication?
rows.translation: 你認為現代科技對溝通有負面影響嗎？

rows.title: Text Message
rows.text: What do you think are some of the main differences between written communication and spoken communication?
rows.translation: 你認為書面溝通和口頭溝通之間，有哪些主要分別？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What kinds of possessions are considered high-status to people in Hong Kong?
rows.translation: 在香港，人們普遍把哪些物品視為高地位象徵？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Were different possessions thought of as valuable in the past?
rows.translation: 在過去，人們會不會把不同的物品看成有價值？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do advertisements give correct information, or do they encourage people to buy things that they may not need?
rows.translation: 廣告提供的資訊是正確的，還是它們會鼓勵人們去買一些自己未必需要的東西？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Where can people hear a lot of noise?
rows.translation: 人們通常會在哪些地方聽到很多噪音？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What may happen when someone listens to very loud music using headphones while they are running or hiking?
rows.translation: 當一個人在跑步或行山時，用耳機聽很大聲的音樂，可能會發生甚麼事？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What can be done to reduce traffic noise?
rows.translation: 可以做些甚麼來減少交通噪音？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think the world will be noisier in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來的世界會變得更嘈雜嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What rules should be imposed to reduce noise pollution in the near future?
rows.translation: 在不久的將來，應該實施哪些規則來減少噪音污染？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What kinds of people are most likely to say sorry?
rows.translation: 甚麼樣的人最容易說對不起？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: In what situations do you think people need to, or should, apologise?
rows.translation: 你認為人在甚麼情況下需要，或者應該道歉？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What do you think of those people who don’t apologise very often?
rows.translation: 你怎樣看那些不太常道歉的人？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What different types of traditional products are produced in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家會生產哪些不同類型的傳統產品？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: In your opinion, why do traditional products attract tourists?
rows.translation: 依你看，為甚麼傳統產品會吸引遊客？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think there are benefits of traditional products to locals?
rows.translation: 你認為傳統產品對本地人有好處嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think the government should help in the promotion of traditional products?
rows.translation: 你認為政府應該幫助推廣傳統產品嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think because of globalisation countries are adopting each other’s traditions?
rows.translation: 你認為因為全球化，各國都在互相吸收彼此的傳統嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think traditional things from the past were of better quality than present-day things?
rows.translation: 你認為過去的傳統物品，品質比現代的東西更好嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think it is necessary to protect traditions?
rows.translation: 你認為有必要保護傳統嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: How do most people travel long distances in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家裡，大多數人長途出行時通常會怎樣旅行？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Have the types of transport people use changed much over the last few decades?
rows.translation: 在過去幾十年裡，人們使用的交通工具有很大改變嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think transport is likely to continue to improve in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來交通很可能會繼續改善嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Have the types of transportation people use changed much over the last few decades?
rows.translation: 在過去幾十年裡，人們使用的交通工具有很大改變嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What kinds of improvement have there been in transport in your country in recent years?
rows.translation: 近年來，你的國家的交通有了哪些改善？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think transportation is likely to continue to improve in the future?
rows.translation: 你認為未來交通很可能會繼續改善嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What is your take on introducing transportation passes?
rows.translation: 你對推行交通月票或乘車通行證有甚麼看法？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: How has transportation improved in recent years?
rows.translation: 近年來，交通有哪些改善？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What is your take on introducing transportation passes?
rows.translation: 你對推行交通月票或乘車通行證有甚麼看法？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What are the impacts of Uber on transportation in your country?
rows.translation: Uber 對你國家的交通帶來了甚麼影響？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think traffic jams would be reduced if people could travel on public transport for free?
rows.translation: 如果人們可以免費乘搭公共交通工具，你認為交通擠塞會減少嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Why do you think more and more people prefer to travel by plane?
rows.translation: 你認為為甚麼愈來愈多人較喜歡坐飛機旅行？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What kinds of obstacles do you think some local governments have to face when they develop transportation infrastructure?
rows.translation: 你認為地方政府在發展交通基建時，通常要面對哪些障礙？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Why do some people prefer to travel abroad rather than travel in their own country?
rows.translation: 為甚麼有些人比起在自己國家旅行，更喜歡出國旅行？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think travelling to another country can change the way that people think?
rows.translation: 你認為去另一個國家旅行會改變人們的想法嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Is it faster to travel by public transportation or by car in your country?
rows.translation: 在你地方，乘搭公共交通工具比較快，還是自己開車比較快？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do you think it’s safer to travel today than in the past?
rows.translation: 你認為現在旅行比過去更安全嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What are some famous tourist spots in your country?
rows.translation: 你國家有哪些著名的旅遊景點？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What are the positive impacts of tourism in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，旅遊業有甚麼正面影響？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What are the negative impacts of tourism in your country?
rows.translation: 在你的國家，旅遊業會帶來哪些負面影響？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Do ratings from other people influence people’s choices?
rows.translation: 別人給出的評分，會影響人們的選擇嗎？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: How do people reserve rooms?
rows.translation: 人們通常怎樣預訂房間？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What influences people’s choice of a hotel?
rows.translation: 甚麼會影響人們選擇酒店？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What can you say about the future of the tourism industry in your country?
rows.translation: 在你所在的地方，你會怎樣看旅遊業的未來？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: Which feature is the most important facility you look for while staying in a hotel?
rows.translation: 酒店住宿時，你最看重哪一項設施或特點？

rows.title: Things
rows.text: What is the difference between a hotel in our country and a hotel abroad?
rows.translation: 我們國家的酒店和外國的酒店有甚麼分別？
